supplications.title: Du'a when Drinking Zamzam
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'an wa rizqan wāsi'an wa shifā'an min kulli dā'.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision, and healing from every illness.
supplications.when_to_recite: While drinking Zamzam water

supplications.title: Du'a Entering the Masjid
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma aftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik.
supplications.translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon entering the mosque, stepping in with the right foot

supplications.title: Du'a Leaving the Masjid
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min faḍlik.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon leaving the mosque, stepping out with the left foot

supplications.title: Salawat Ibrahim (Durood Ibrahim)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli 'alā Muḥammadin wa 'alā āli Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta 'alā Ibrāhīma wa 'alā āli Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd. Allāhumma bārik 'alā Muḥammadin wa 'alā āli Muḥammadin kamā bārakta 'alā Ibrāhīma wa 'alā āli Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious.
supplications.when_to_recite: In the final tashahhud of every prayer, and when sending salutations upon the Prophet ﷺ

supplications.title: Istighfar — Seeking Forgiveness
supplications.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
supplications.transliteration: Astaghfiru Allāhal-'Aẓīmallādhī lā ilāha illā Huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūmu wa atūbu ilayh.
supplications.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Magnificent, other than whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all, and I repent to Him.
supplications.when_to_recite: After committing a sin, after prayer, or at any time

supplications.title: Tasbih — Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
supplications.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi walḥamdulillāhi wa lā ilāha illallāhu wallāhu akbar.
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no deity but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening, after prayer, and throughout the day

supplications.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar (Master of Forgiveness)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā ant, khalaqtanī wa anā 'abduk, wa anā 'alā 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'ūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣana't, abū'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abū'u bidhanbī faghfir lī fa'innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant.
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am upon Your covenant and promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening. Whoever says it in the morning with firm belief and dies that day enters Paradise; same for the evening.

supplications.title: Du'a for Complete Forgiveness
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī dhanbī kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa ākhirahu, wa 'alāniyatahu wa sirrahu.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive me all my sins — the small and the great, the first and the last, the public and the secret.
supplications.when_to_recite: After prayer, during prostration, or when seeking complete forgiveness

supplications.title: Du'a of Sincere Repentance
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa illam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā lanakūnanna minal-khāsirīn.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking sincere repentance; the du'a of Adam and Hawwa alayhima as-salam

supplications.title: Du'a for a Good Ending (Husnul Khatimah)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالْإِسْلَامِ وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِأَحْسَنِ الأَعْمَالِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummakhtim lanā bil-islāmi wakhtim lanā bil-īmāni wakhtim lanā bi-aḥsanil-a'māl.
supplications.translation: O Allah, seal our lives with Islam, seal our lives with faith, and seal our lives with the best of deeds.
supplications.when_to_recite: Frequently, especially in old age or illness
supplications.source: Based on prophetic teachings on husn al-khatimah

supplications.title: Du'a for Healing (Shifa)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma rabban-nāsi adhhibil-ba's, washfi antash-shāfī, lā shifā'a illā shifā'uka shifā'an lā yughādiru saqamā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction and cure [them], for You are the Healer. There is no cure except Your cure — a cure that leaves no illness behind.
supplications.when_to_recite: When visiting the sick, or when sick yourself

supplications.title: Du'a for Full Bodily Health (Aafiya)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma 'āfinī fī badanī. Allāhumma 'āfinī fī sam'ī. Allāhumma 'āfinī fī baṣarī. Lā ilāha illā ant.
supplications.translation: O Allah, grant me health in my body. O Allah, grant me health in my hearing. O Allah, grant me health in my sight. There is no deity but You.
supplications.when_to_recite: Every morning; seek 'afiyah (wellbeing) in this world and the next

supplications.title: Du'a for Protection from Disease
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الأَسْقَامِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-baraṣi wal-junūni wal-judhāmi wa min sayyi'il-asqām.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy, insanity, elephantiasis, and from severe diseases.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning protection adhkar

supplications.title: Du'a for Patience and Endurance
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā ja'altahu sahlā wa anta taj'alul-ḥazna idhā shi'ta sahlā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You can make the difficult easy if You wish.
supplications.when_to_recite: When facing hardship, heat, or physical difficulty

supplications.title: Du'a for Righteous Children
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
supplications.translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.
supplications.when_to_recite: When asking Allah for righteous children; the du'a of Ibrahim alayhis salam

supplications.title: Du'a for a Righteous Family
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata a'yunin waj'alnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader for the righteous.
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying for one's spouse, children, and family

supplications.title: Du'a for Parents and Believers
supplications.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbighfir lī wa liwālidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināt.
supplications.translation: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer, and all believing men and women.
supplications.when_to_recite: When asking forgiveness for oneself, parents, and the believing community; du'a of Nuh alayhis salam

supplications.title: Du'a for Children Who Pray
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbij'alnī muqīmaṣ-ṣalāti wa min dhurriyyatī rabbanā wa taqabbal du'ā'.
supplications.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying that your children maintain their prayers

supplications.title: Du'a for Gratitude and Righteous Deeds
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nī an ashkura ni'matakallatī an'amta 'alayya wa 'alā wālidayya wa an a'mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī.
supplications.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve, and make righteous for me my offspring.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking gratitude and righteous family; du'a recommended at age 40

supplications.title: Du'a for Lawful Provision and Sufficiency
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummakfinī biḥalālika 'an ḥarāmika wa aghnini bifaḍlika 'amman siwāk.
supplications.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful, away from what You have made unlawful, and make me independent of all others besides You.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking halal provision and sufficiency

supplications.title: Du'a for Guidance, Piety, and Contentment
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-hudā wat-tuqā wal-'afāfa wal-ghinā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.
supplications.when_to_recite: A comprehensive daily supplication for everything a Muslim needs

supplications.title: Du'a for Relief from Difficulty
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ سَهْلًا إِذَا شِئْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā ja'altahu sahlā wa anta taj'alul-ḥazna sahlā idhā shi't.
supplications.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make grief easy when You will.
supplications.when_to_recite: When facing any difficulty or hardship

supplications.title: Du'a for Divine Guidance and Success (Tawfiq)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma aṣliḥ lī dīniyal-ladhī huwa 'iṣmatu amrī wa aṣliḥ lī dunyāyallatī fīhā ma'āshī wa aṣliḥ lī ākhiratillatī fīhā ma'ādī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs; set right for me my world wherein is my livelihood; and set right for me my Hereafter which is my return.
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — a comprehensive du'a for success in religion, worldly life, and the hereafter

supplications.title: Du'a for Barakah in Wealth
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīmā razaqtanā wa qinā 'adhāban-nār.
supplications.translation: O Allah, bless what You have provided us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
supplications.when_to_recite: When receiving provision or earnings; asking for barakah

supplications.title: Du'a for Relief from Anxiety and Debt
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazani wal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-bukhli wal-jubni wa ḍala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and being overpowered by people.
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling anxious, worried, in debt, or overwhelmed

supplications.title: Salat al-Janaza — Main Du'a
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lahu warḥamhu wa 'āfihi wa'fu 'anhu wa akrim nuzulahu wa wassi' madkhalahu waghsilhu bil-mā'i wath-thalji wal-baradi wa naqqihi minal-khaṭāyā kamā yunaqqath-thawbul-abyaḍu minad-danas.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, and excuse him and pardon him, and make his entrance generous and widen his dwelling, and wash him with water, snow, and hail, and cleanse him from sins as a white garment is cleansed of filth.
supplications.when_to_recite: Third takbir of Salat al-Janaza. For a female say 'ha' instead of 'hu'. ⚑ Janaza prayers are offered daily after Fajr at Masjid al-Haram and Masjid al-Nabawi — one of the greatest opportunities for reward.

supplications.title: Du'a for All Muslims — Living and Deceased
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنثَانَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir liḥayyinā wa mayyitinā wa shāhidinā wa ghā'ibinā wa ṣaghīrinā wa kabīrinā wa dhakārinā wa unthānā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our male and our female.
supplications.when_to_recite: In Salat al-Janaza (4th takbir), or when making du'a for the Muslim community

supplications.title: Du'a for Deceased Parents
supplications.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbighfir lī wa liwālidayya warḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā.
supplications.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small.
supplications.when_to_recite: When making du'a for deceased parents; continue making this du'a — it benefits the dead

supplications.title: Du'a for All Deceased Muslims
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالأَمْوَاتِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lil-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-muslimīna wal-muslimātil-aḥyā'i minhum wal-amwāt.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive the believing men and believing women, and the Muslim men and Muslim women — the living among them and the deceased.
supplications.when_to_recite: After prayers, when making du'a for the entire Muslim community
supplications.source: Based on Quran 47:19 and prophetic practice

supplications.title: Du'a when Visiting Graves
supplications.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
supplications.transliteration: As-salāmu 'alaykum ahlad-diyāri minal-mu'minīna wal-muslimīna wa innā in shā'allāhu bikum lāḥiqūn, nas'alullāha lanā wa lakumul-'āfiyah.
supplications.translation: Peace be upon you, O people of the dwellings — the believers and Muslims. We will indeed join you, if Allah wills. We ask Allah for wellbeing for us and for you.
supplications.when_to_recite: When visiting the graveyard — especially Jannatul Baqi (Madinah) and Jannatul Mualla (Makkah)

supplications.title: Du'a for a Righteous Spouse
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.
supplications.translation: My Lord, indeed I am in need of whatever good You would send down to me.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking a spouse, provision, or anything good from Allah; the du'a of Musa alayhis salam

supplications.title: Du'a for Blessings on a Married Couple
supplications.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
supplications.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka wa bāraka 'alayka wa jama'a baynakumā fī khayr.
supplications.translation: May Allah bless you and bestow blessings upon you, and may He unite you both in good.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said to a newly married person; the du'a taught by the Prophet ﷺ

supplications.title: Du'a Before Intimacy with Spouse
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāh, Allāhumma jannibnash-shayṭāna wa jannibish-shayṭāna mā razaqtanā.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep us away from Shaytan and keep Shaytan away from what You bless us with.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before intimacy with one's spouse — if a child is conceived, Shaytan will not harm them

supplications.title: Du'a for Protection from the Evil Eye
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmatin wa min kulli 'aynin lāmmah.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said over children for protection; used by the Prophet ﷺ for Hasan and Husayn

supplications.title: Morning & Evening Protection
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāhilladhī lā yaḍurru ma'asmihī shay'un fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā'i wa huwas-samī'ul-'alīm.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth or heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times each morning and evening — whoever says this will not be harmed

supplications.title: Du'a for Trust in Allah — Complete Reliance
supplications.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
supplications.transliteration: Ḥasbunallāhu wa ni'mal-wakīl.
supplications.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
supplications.when_to_recite: When facing fear, difficulty, or uncertainty — the words of Ibrahim alayhis salam in the fire

supplications.title: Du'a for Protection from All Directions
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummahfaẓnī min bayni yadayya wa min khalfī wa 'an yamīnī wa 'an shimālī wa min fawqī wa a'ūdhu bi'aẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, protect me from in front of me, behind me, to my right, to my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being swallowed from below.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning protection — comprehensive protection in all directions

supplications.title: Du'a for Oppressed Muslims Worldwide
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْصُرِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma unṣuril-muslimīnal-mustaḍ'afīna fī kulli makān.
supplications.translation: O Allah, grant victory to the oppressed Muslims in every place.
supplications.when_to_recite: After prayers, especially in times of Muslim suffering worldwide
supplications.source: Based on prophetic du'a for the weak and oppressed

supplications.title: Du'a for Unity of the Muslim Ummah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِهِمْ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma allif bayna qulūbil-muslimīna wa aṣliḥ dhāta baynihim.
supplications.translation: O Allah, unite the hearts of the Muslims and set right the affairs between them.
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying for the unity and harmony of the Muslim community

supplications.title: Du'a for Patience and Victory
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā afrigh 'alaynā ṣabran wa thabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā 'alal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of the army of Dawud alayhis salam; recited when facing oppression or seeking victory

supplications.title: Du'a for Righteous Muslim Leaders
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَلِّ عَلَيْنَا خِيَارَنَا وَلَا تُوَلِّ عَلَيْنَا شِرَارَنَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma walli 'alaynā khiyāranā wa lā tuwalli 'alaynā shirāranā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, appoint over us our best ones and do not appoint over us our worst ones.
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying for righteous leadership in Muslim lands

supplications.title: Du'a of Ibrahim ﷺ — Accept From Us
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā taqabbal minnā innaka antas-samī'ul-'alīm.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
supplications.when_to_recite: After any act of worship — prayer, fasting, charity, Hajj. The du'a of Ibrahim and Ismail alayhima as-salam after building the Kaaba.

supplications.title: Du'a for an Accepted Hajj (Mabroor)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ حَجًّا مَبْرُورًا وَذَنْبًا مَغْفُورًا وَسَعْيًا مَشْكُورًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaj'alhu ḥajjan mabrūran wa dhanban maghfūran wa sa'yan mashkūrā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, make it an accepted Hajj, a forgiven sin, and an appreciated effort.
supplications.when_to_recite: Throughout Hajj and upon its completion
supplications.source: Authenticated by scholars of Hajj fiqh

supplications.title: Du'a for Laylatul Qadr and Sacred Nights
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka 'afuwwun tuḥibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'annī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
supplications.when_to_recite: Especially on the nights of the last 10 days of Ramadan seeking Laylatul Qadr, and on all sacred nights

supplications.title: Istikhara — Du'a for Guidance in Decisions
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka bi'ilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratika wa as'aluka min faḍlikal-'aẓīmi fa'innaka taqdiru wa lā aqdiru wa ta'lamu wa lā a'lamu wa anta 'allāmul-ghuyūb.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge and Your strength through Your power, and I ask You of Your great bounty. You are capable and I am not. You know and I do not know, and You are the Knower of unseen things.
supplications.when_to_recite: After 2 rakaat (non-obligatory) prayer when making an important decision

supplications.title: Du'a for Increase in Knowledge
supplications.arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi zidnī 'ilmā.
supplications.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before studying, learning, or any pursuit of knowledge — the only place Allah commanded the Prophet ﷺ to ask for 'more'

supplications.title: Du'a for Open Heart and Clear Speech
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
supplications.transliteration: Rabbish-raḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī waḥlul 'uqdatan min lisānī yafqahū qawlī.
supplications.translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest and ease my task for me and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before speaking in public, teaching, giving advice, or any important task; du'a of Musa alayhis salam

supplications.title: Du'a for Protection from Useless Knowledge
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min 'ilmin lā yanfa'u wa min qalbin lā yakhsha'u wa min nafsin lā tashba'u wa min da'watin lā yustajābu lahā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that is of no benefit, and from a heart that does not fear, and from a soul that is not satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.
supplications.when_to_recite: A comprehensive protection du'a; recited by the Prophet ﷺ after Fajr

supplications.title: Morning Du'a — Beginning the Day
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika amsaynā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilaykан-nushūr.
supplications.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, and by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
supplications.when_to_recite: In the morning upon waking

supplications.title: Evening Du'a — Beginning the Night
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma bika amsaynā wa bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilaykal-maṣīr.
supplications.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, and by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the return.
supplications.when_to_recite: In the evening at sunset

supplications.title: Protection from Harm — Morning & Evening
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāhilladhī lā yaḍurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā'i wa huwas-samī'ul-'alīm.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth or heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times every morning and evening — whoever says this will not be harmed

supplications.title: Contentment with Allah, Islam, and the Prophet
supplications.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
supplications.transliteration: Raḍītu billāhi rabban wa bil-islāmi dīnan wa bi-Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu 'alayhi wa sallama nabiyyā.
supplications.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times every morning and evening — whoever says this, Allah guarantees His pleasure for them

supplications.title: Tahlil — Morning Dhikr (10 times)
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
supplications.translation: There is no deity but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able to do all things.
supplications.when_to_recite: 10 times every morning — equal in reward to freeing 4 slaves, 10 good deeds recorded, 10 sins erased

supplications.title: Glorification — 100 Times Morning & Evening
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdih.
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah and all praise is for Him.
supplications.when_to_recite: 100 times each morning and evening — sins forgiven even if like the foam of the sea

supplications.title: Most Beloved Dhikr — Comprehensive Tasbih
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdihi 'adada khalqihi wa riḍā nafsihi wa zinata 'arshihi wa midāda kalimātih.
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah and all praise is for Him — as many times as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His throne, and as much as the ink of His words.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times every morning — it outweighs all other dhikr

supplications.title: Master of Seeking Forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā ant, khalaqtanī wa anā 'abduk, wa anā 'alā 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastaṭa't, a'ūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣana't, abū'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abū'u bidhanbī faghfir lī fa'innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant.
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am upon Your covenant and promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
supplications.when_to_recite: Once every morning and evening with certainty — enters Paradise if one dies that day

supplications.title: Du'a for Wellbeing — Morning & Evening
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-'afwa wal-'āfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in this world and the next.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — the Prophet ﷺ never left this du'a

supplications.title: Sufficiency in Allah — Morning & Evening
supplications.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'aẓīm.
supplications.translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity but Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
supplications.when_to_recite: Seven times every morning and evening — Allah will suffice whoever says this

supplications.title: Du'a — Bearing Witness to Allah's Oneness
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ushhiduka wa ushidu ḥamalata 'arshika wa malā'ikataka wa jamī'a khalqika annaka anta Allāhu lā ilāha illā anta wa anna Muḥammadan 'abduka wa rasūluk.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I call You to witness, and [I call] the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness, that You are Allah — there is no deity but You — and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your Messenger.
supplications.when_to_recite: Four times every morning and evening — one quarter of the Quran's reward and 70,000 angels seek forgiveness for whoever says this

supplications.title: Ayat al-Kursi — Morning & Evening
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūm, lā ta'khudhuhū sinatun wa lā nawm, lahū mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ...
supplications.translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth...
supplications.when_to_recite: Once every morning and evening — a guardian is appointed and Shaytan does not approach

supplications.title: Al-Mu'awwidhat — Three Quls (Morning & Evening)
supplications.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ...
supplications.transliteration: Qul huwa Allāhu aḥad... Qul a'ūdhu bi-rabbil-falaq... Qul a'ūdhu bi-rabbin-nās...
supplications.translation: Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq, and Surah An-Nas — recited three times each.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times each morning and evening — sufficient protection for everything

supplications.title: Seeking Refuge from Worry and Debt
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazani wal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-bukhli wal-jubni wa ḍala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and being overpowered by people.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening

supplications.title: Gratitude for Morning Blessings
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min ni'matin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika faminka waḥdaka lā sharīka laka falakal-ḥamdu wa lakash-shukr.
supplications.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I have or any of Your creation has this morning is from You alone, with no partner. To You is all praise and to You is all gratitude.
supplications.when_to_recite: Once every morning — whoever says this fulfils the day's obligation of gratitude

supplications.title: Gratitude for Evening Blessings
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma mā amsā bī min ni'matin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika faminka waḥdaka lā sharīka laka falakal-ḥamdu wa lakash-shukr.
supplications.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I have or any of Your creation has this evening is from You alone, with no partner. To You is all praise and to You is all gratitude.
supplications.when_to_recite: Once every evening — whoever says this fulfils the evening's obligation of gratitude

supplications.title: Seeking Forgiveness 100 Times
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbighfir lī wa tub 'alayya innaka anta tawwābur-raḥīm.
supplications.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. Indeed You are the Ever-Accepting of Repentance, the Most Merciful.
supplications.when_to_recite: The Prophet ﷺ used to say this 100 times a day

supplications.title: Morning Du'a for Knowledge, Provision and Deeds
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'an wa rizqan ṭayyiban wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
supplications.when_to_recite: After Fajr prayer every morning

supplications.title: Du'a for the Good of this Day
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayra hādhal-yawm, fatḥahu wa naṣrahu wa nūrahu wa barakatahu wa hudāh.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day — its opening, its victory, its light, its blessings, and its guidance.
supplications.when_to_recite: In the morning when starting the day

supplications.title: Leaving Home — Trust in Allah
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāh, tawakkaltu 'alallāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power or strength except with Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: When leaving the home — one is guided, protected and guarded when saying this

supplications.title: Morning Declaration of Servitude
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ عَرْشَكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu ushiduka wa ushidu 'arshaka wa malā'ikataka wa jamī'a khalqika bi-annaka anta Allāhu lā ilāha illā ant.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I begin this morning calling You to witness, and Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation, that You are Allah — there is no deity but You.
supplications.when_to_recite: Four times every morning

supplications.title: Three Requests for Wellbeing — Morning
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma 'āfinī fī badanī. Allāhumma 'āfinī fī sam'ī. Allāhumma 'āfinī fī baṣarī. Lā ilāha illā ant.
supplications.translation: O Allah, grant me health in my body. O Allah, grant me health in my hearing. O Allah, grant me health in my sight. There is no deity but You.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times every morning and evening

supplications.title: La Hawla wa La Quwwata — Treasure of Paradise
supplications.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
supplications.translation: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: Frequently throughout the day and night — a treasure from the treasures of Paradise

supplications.title: Du'a for a Good Evening
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayra hādhihil-laylati wa khayra mā ba'dahā wa a'ūdhu bika min sharri hādhihil-laylati wa sharri mā ba'dahā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what comes after it.
supplications.when_to_recite: In the evening

supplications.title: Seeking Refuge at Evening
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times in the evening — whoever says this will not be harmed by any poison or stings

supplications.title: Salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ — Morning & Evening
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik 'alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa 'alā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajma'īn.
supplications.translation: O Allah, send your blessings, peace, and grace upon our master Muhammad and upon all his family and companions.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — sending 10 blessings in return for each salawat

supplications.title: Du'a for Light in All Directions
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaj'al fī qalbī nūran wa fī lisānī nūran wa fī sam'ī nūran wa fī baṣarī nūran wa min fawqī nūran wa min taḥtī nūrā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, place light in my heart, light on my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light from above me and light from below me.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning — from the Prophet's ﷺ comprehensive du'a for light

supplications.title: Istighfar After Prayer (3 times)
supplications.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
supplications.transliteration: Astaghfirullāh.
supplications.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times immediately after completing the salam

supplications.title: Du'a — Allah is Peace
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma anta as-salāmu wa minkas-salāmu tabārakta yā dhal-jalāli wal-ikrām.
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.
supplications.when_to_recite: After every obligatory prayer, immediately after the salam

supplications.title: Tasbih — 33×33×34 After Prayer
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ ۝ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۝ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
supplications.transliteration: Subḥānallāh (33×). Alḥamdulillāh (33×). Allāhu akbar (34×).
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah (33×). All praise is for Allah (33×). Allah is the Greatest (34×).
supplications.when_to_recite: After every obligatory prayer — sins forgiven even if like the foam of the sea

supplications.title: Seal of Tasbih After Prayer
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
supplications.translation: There is no deity but Allah alone with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is able to do all things.
supplications.when_to_recite: After completing the 33+33+34 tasbih

supplications.title: Ayat al-Kursi After Prayer
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ...
supplications.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūm...
supplications.translation: Recite Ayat al-Kursi (2:255) once after every obligatory prayer.
supplications.when_to_recite: After every obligatory prayer — whoever recites it will enter Paradise upon death

supplications.title: Du'a after Fajr — Protection for the Day
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'an wa rizqan ṭayyiban wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
supplications.when_to_recite: Specifically after Fajr prayer, before the sun rises

supplications.title: Du'a — Three Matters None Can Give But Allah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma a'innī 'alā dhikrika wa shukrika wa ḥusni 'ibādatik.
supplications.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best manner.
supplications.when_to_recite: After every prayer — the Prophet ﷺ taught this to Mu'adh ibn Jabal as counsel not to leave it

supplications.title: Three Surahs After Maghrib and Fajr
supplications.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ...
supplications.transliteration: Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas — three times after Fajr and Maghrib.
supplications.translation: Recite the three Quls (Ikhlas, Falaq, Nas) three times each after Fajr and Maghrib prayers.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times after Fajr and Maghrib — protection for the remainder of the day/night

supplications.title: Remembrance of Allah After Prayer
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu yuḥyī wa yumītu wa huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
supplications.translation: There is no deity but Allah alone with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise. He gives life and causes death and He is able to do all things.
supplications.when_to_recite: 10 times after Maghrib and Fajr

supplications.title: Du'a for Paradise After Prayer
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-jannata wa a'ūdhu bika minan-nār.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
supplications.when_to_recite: After every prayer — the Prophet ﷺ said whoever asks for Jannah three times, Jannah asks Allah to admit them

supplications.title: Du'a for Parents After Prayer
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbighfir lī wa liwālidayya warḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā.
supplications.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small.
supplications.when_to_recite: After every prayer — especially for those with elderly or deceased parents

supplications.title: Du'a After Wudu
supplications.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
supplications.transliteration: Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan 'abduhu wa rasūluh.
supplications.translation: I bear witness that there is no deity but Allah alone with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
supplications.when_to_recite: After completing wudu (ablution) — the 8 gates of Paradise open for whoever says this

supplications.title: Du'a in Prostration (Sujud)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī dhanbī kullahu diqqahu wa jillahu wa awwalahu wa ākhirahu wa 'alāniyatahu wa sirrahu.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive me all my sins — the small and great, the first and last, the public and secret.
supplications.when_to_recite: In prostration (sujud) — the closest a servant is to their Lord

supplications.title: Full Tashahhud
supplications.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
supplications.transliteration: At-taḥiyyātu lillāhi waṣ-ṣalawātu waṭ-ṭayyibāt, as-salāmu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh, as-salāmu 'alaynā wa 'alā 'ibādillāhiṣ-ṣāliḥīn, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illallāhu wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan 'abduhu wa rasūluh.
supplications.translation: All greetings, prayers and good things belong to Allah. Peace be upon you O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no deity but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
supplications.when_to_recite: In the sitting (tashahhhud) of every prayer

supplications.title: Du'a Before Salam — Seeking Refuge from Four Things
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min 'adhābil-qabri wa min 'adhābin-nāri wa min fitnatil-maḥyā wal-mamāti wa min fitnatil-masīḥid-dajjāl.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of the Fire, from the trial of life and death, and from the trial of the False Messiah (Dajjal).
supplications.when_to_recite: In the final tashahhud, before giving salam — the Prophet ﷺ commanded this

supplications.title: Du'a Entering the Home
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayral-mawliji wa khayral-makhraj. Bismillāhi walajnā wa bismillāhi kharajnā wa 'alallāhi rabbinā tawakkalnā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of entering and the good of leaving. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon entering one's home

supplications.title: Du'a Leaving the Home
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāh, tawakkaltu 'alallāh, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power or strength except with Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: When leaving home — one is guided, protected, and Shaytan is kept away

supplications.title: Du'a Entering the Toilet
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khabā'ith.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female evil spirits (jinn).
supplications.when_to_recite: Before entering the toilet, while saying Bismillah and entering with the left foot

supplications.title: Du'a Leaving the Toilet
supplications.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
supplications.transliteration: Ghufrānak.
supplications.translation: I seek Your forgiveness.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon exiting the toilet

supplications.title: Du'a Before Eating
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى بَرَكَةِ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāhi wa 'alā barakatillāh.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah and with the blessings of Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before starting every meal — say it if you forget to say it before and then remember

supplications.title: Du'a When Forgetting Bismillah at Meal
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāhi awwalahu wa ākhirah.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and its end.
supplications.when_to_recite: If you forgot to say Bismillah before eating and remember during the meal

supplications.title: Du'a After Eating
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
supplications.transliteration: Alḥamdulillāhilladhī aṭ'amanī hādhā wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah.
supplications.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.
supplications.when_to_recite: After finishing any meal

supplications.title: Du'a After Drinking Milk
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa zidnā minh.
supplications.translation: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.
supplications.when_to_recite: After drinking milk — the Prophet ﷺ said there is nothing that can substitute for both food and drink except milk

supplications.title: Du'a When Looking in the Mirror
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma anta ḥassanta khalqī faḥassin khuluqī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, You have made my physical form beautiful, so make my character beautiful too.
supplications.when_to_recite: When looking in the mirror

supplications.title: Du'a When Wearing New Clothes
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma lakal-ḥamdu anta kasawtanīhi as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri mā ṣuni'a lahu wa a'ūdhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri mā ṣuni'a lah.
supplications.translation: O Allah, all praise is for You. You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good it was made for, and I seek Your refuge from its evil and the evil it was made for.
supplications.when_to_recite: When wearing a new garment

supplications.title: Du'a Before Sleeping — Full Tasbih
supplications.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
supplications.transliteration: Bismika Allāhumma amūtu wa aḥyā.
supplications.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
supplications.when_to_recite: When going to sleep every night

supplications.title: Ayat al-Kursi Before Sleeping
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ...
supplications.transliteration: Recite Ayat al-Kursi (2:255) before sleeping.
supplications.translation: Recite Ayat al-Kursi before sleeping — a guardian stays with you and Shaytan does not approach until morning.
supplications.when_to_recite: Every night before sleeping

supplications.title: Tasbih Before Sleeping (33×33×34)
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ ۝ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۝ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
supplications.transliteration: SubḥānAllāh (33×), Alḥamdulillāh (33×), Allāhu Akbar (34×).
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah (33), All praise is for Allah (33), Allah is the Greatest (34).
supplications.when_to_recite: Before sleeping — better for you than a servant to serve you

supplications.title: Du'a Upon Waking Up
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
supplications.transliteration: Alḥamdulillāhilladhī aḥyānā ba'da mā amātanā wa ilayhin-nushūr.
supplications.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon waking up from sleep

supplications.title: Three Surahs Before Sleeping
supplications.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ...
supplications.transliteration: Recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas — blow into hands and wipe over the body (3 times).
supplications.translation: Recite the three Quls, blow into cupped hands, then wipe over as much of the body as possible — three times each night before sleeping.
supplications.when_to_recite: Every night before sleeping — the Prophet ﷺ never left this

supplications.title: Du'a After a Bad Dream
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ هَذِهِ الرُّؤْيَا
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīmi wa min sharri hādhihir-ru'yā.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan and from the evil of this dream.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon waking from a nightmare — then spit lightly to the left three times and turn to the other side

supplications.title: Du'a Before Entering the Masjid (Full)
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu billāhil-'aẓīmi wa biwajhihil-karīmi wa sulṭānihil-qadīmi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in Allah the Mighty, in His noble face, and in His eternal authority, from the accursed Shaytan.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said when approaching the mosque door — Shaytan says 'this one is protected all day'

supplications.title: Du'a When Sneezing
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Alḥamdulillāh.
supplications.translation: All praise is for Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: When sneezing — the response from those who hear is 'Yarhamukallah' and you reply 'Yahdikumullahu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum'

supplications.title: Response to Someone Who Sneezes
supplications.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Yarḥamukallāh.
supplications.translation: May Allah have mercy upon you.
supplications.when_to_recite: When someone sneezes and says Alhamdulillah — a Muslim's right upon their brother/sister

supplications.title: Reply to Yarhamukallah
supplications.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
supplications.transliteration: Yahdīkumullāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum.
supplications.translation: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order.
supplications.when_to_recite: Reply when someone says 'Yarhamukallah' to you

supplications.title: Du'a Entering the Market
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu yuḥyī wa yumītu wa huwa ḥayyun lā yamūtu biyadihil-khayru wa huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
supplications.translation: There is no deity but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise. He gives life and causes death, while He lives and never dies. In His hand is all good, and He is able to do all things.
supplications.when_to_recite: When entering the marketplace — Allah records a million good deeds and erases a million sins

supplications.title: Du'a When Feeling Angry
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan.
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling angry — the Prophet ﷺ said anger comes from Shaytan, and seeking refuge in Allah extinguishes it

supplications.title: Du'a When Distressed
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.
supplications.translation: There is no deity but You; glory be to You. Indeed I have been of the wrongdoers.
supplications.when_to_recite: When in any distress or difficulty — the du'a of Yunus alayhis salam in the whale. No Muslim recites it in distress except that Allah relieves it.

supplications.title: Du'a Upon First Seeing the Kaaba
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْ هَذَا الْبَيْتَ تَشْرِيفًا وَتَعْظِيمًا وَتَكْرِيمًا وَمَهَابَةً وَزِدْ مَنْ شَرَّفَهُ وَكَرَّمَهُ مِمَّنْ حَجَّهُ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَهُ تَشْرِيفًا وَتَكْرِيمًا وَتَعْظِيمًا وَبِرًّا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma zid hādhal-bayta tashrīfan wa ta'ẓīman wa takrīman wa mahābatan, wa zid man sharrafahū wa karramahū mimman ḥajjahu awi'tamarahū tashrīfan wa takrīman wa ta'ẓīman wa birrā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, increase this House in honour, reverence, nobility and awe, and increase those who honour and revere it — those who make Hajj or Umrah — in honour, nobility, reverence, and righteousness.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon first sighting the Kaaba

supplications.title: Du'a When Hearing Thunder
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Subḥānal-ladhī yusabbiḥur-ra'du biḥamdihi wal-malā'ikatu min khīfatih.
supplications.translation: Glory be to He Whom thunder and the angels glorify out of fear of Him.
supplications.when_to_recite: When hearing thunder

supplications.title: Du'a When It Rains
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfi'ā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, [make it] a beneficial downpour.
supplications.when_to_recite: When rain begins to fall

supplications.title: Du'a During Heavy or Harmful Rain
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ḥawālaynā wa lā 'alaynā. Allāhumma 'alal-ākāmi waẓ-ẓirābi wa buṭūnil-awdiyati wa manābiti ash-shajar.
supplications.translation: O Allah, let it rain around us and not upon us. O Allah, let it rain on the hills, valleys, and roots of the trees.
supplications.when_to_recite: When rain is excessive or causing harm

supplications.title: Du'a After Rain
supplications.arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Muṭirnā bifaḍlillāhi wa raḥmatih.
supplications.translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: After it has rained

supplications.title: Du'a During Strong Wind
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra mā fīhā wa khayra mā ursilat bihi wa a'ūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā fīhā wa sharri mā ursilat bih.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of it and the good within it and the good it was sent with, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil within it and the evil it was sent with.
supplications.when_to_recite: When wind is blowing strongly

supplications.title: Du'a When Seeing the New Moon
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالأَمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالإِسْلَامِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhu akbar. Allāhumma ahillahu 'alaynā bil-amni wal-īmāni was-salāmati wal-islāmi rabbī wa rabbukallāh.
supplications.translation: Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, let this moon appear over us with security, faith, safety, and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: When sighting the new moon (hilal) at the start of each Islamic month

supplications.title: Du'a When Breaking the Fast (Iftar)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma laka ṣumtu wa bika āmantu wa 'alayka tawakkaltu wa 'alā rizqika afṭart.
supplications.translation: O Allah, for You I fasted, in You I believe, upon You I rely, and with Your provision I break my fast.
supplications.when_to_recite: When breaking the fast at Maghrib

supplications.title: Du'a After Breaking Fast
supplications.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Dhahaba aẓ-ẓama'u wabtallatil-'urūqu wa thabatal-ajru in shā'allāh.
supplications.translation: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is established, if Allah wills.
supplications.when_to_recite: After breaking the fast

supplications.title: Du'a Entering a New Town or City
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma rabbas-samāwātis-sab'i wa mā aẓlalna wa rabbal-araḍīnas-sab'i wa mā aqallna, as'aluka khayra hādhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahlihā wa khayra mā fīhā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they shade, Lord of the seven earths and all they carry — I ask You for the good of this town, the good of its people, and the good of all that is in it.
supplications.when_to_recite: When entering a new city or town

supplications.title: Du'a at the Start of a Journey
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innā nas'aluka fī safarinā hādhal-birra wat-taqwā wa minal-'amali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin 'alaynā safaranā hādhā waṭwi 'annā bu'dah.
supplications.translation: O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey of ours easy and fold up its distance for us.
supplications.when_to_recite: At the beginning of any journey

supplications.title: Du'a When Mounting a Vehicle or Plane
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
supplications.transliteration: Subḥānal-ladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīna wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn.
supplications.translation: Glory be to He who has subjected this to us, and we were not [otherwise] capable of it, and indeed we shall return to our Lord.
supplications.when_to_recite: When boarding any vehicle, plane, ship, or car

supplications.title: Du'a Upon Safe Return from Travel
supplications.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
supplications.transliteration: Āyibūna tā'ibūna 'ābidūna lirabbinā ḥāmidūn.
supplications.translation: We return, we repent, we worship, and we praise our Lord.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said repeatedly when returning from travel

supplications.title: Du'a When Stopping at a Rest Place
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
supplications.when_to_recite: When stopping at a resting place during travel — no harm will touch whoever says this until they leave

supplications.title: Du'a When Setting Out for Hajj or Umrah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ تَوَجَّهْتُ وَبِكَ اعْتَصَمْتُ اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي مَا أَهَمَّنِي وَمَا لَا أَهْتَمُّ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ زَوِّدْنِي التَّقْوَى
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ilayka tawajjahtu wa bika i'taṣamtu. Allāhummakfinī mā ahammani wa mā lā ahtammu lah. Allāhumma zawwidnit-taqwā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, to You I have turned and in You I have sought refuge. O Allah, spare me from that which worries me and that which I do not worry about. O Allah, provide me with taqwa as my provision.
supplications.when_to_recite: When departing for Hajj or Umrah — the best provision is taqwa (Quran 2:197)

supplications.title: Du'a When Fearing the Road
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min wa'thā'is-safari wa ka'ābatil-munqalabi wa sū'il-manẓari fil-ahli wal-māl.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek Your refuge from the hardship of travel, from returning in grief, and from finding a bad situation in family and wealth.
supplications.when_to_recite: When beginning a journey — the Prophet ﷺ said this at the start of every journey

supplications.title: Du'a When Leaving Family for Travel
supplications.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
supplications.transliteration: Astawdi'ukumullāhal-ladhī lā taḍī'u wadā'i'uh.
supplications.translation: I entrust you to Allah, in Whose care nothing is ever lost.
supplications.when_to_recite: When saying farewell to family before travel

supplications.title: Response When Someone Leaves for Travel
supplications.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Astawdi'ullāha dīnaka wa amānataka wa khawātīma 'amalik.
supplications.translation: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and the seal of your deeds.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said to someone departing on a journey

supplications.title: Du'a When Travelling at Night
supplications.arabic: يَا أَرْضُ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكِ اللَّهُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّكِ وَشَرِّ مَا خُلِقَ فِيكِ وَشَرِّ مَا يَدُبُّ عَلَيْكِ
supplications.transliteration: Yā arḍu rabbī wa rabbukillāh, a'ūdhu billāhi min sharriki wa sharri mā khuliqa fīki wa sharri mā yadubbu 'alayk.
supplications.translation: O earth! My Lord and your Lord is Allah. I seek refuge in Allah from your evil and the evil of what is created in you and the evil of what walks upon you.
supplications.when_to_recite: When stopping to rest during night travel or when in an unfamiliar place

supplications.title: Du'a When Afraid During Travel
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innā naj'aluka fī nuḥūrihim wa na'ūdhu bika min shurūrihim.
supplications.translation: O Allah, we place You before them and seek refuge in You from their evils.
supplications.when_to_recite: When afraid of a people or danger during travel

supplications.title: Du'a When Lost or in Difficulty During Travel
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا وَلِيَّ الإِسْلَامِ وَأَهْلِهِ ثَبِّتْنِي بِهِ حَتَّى أَلْقَاكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma yā waliyyāl-islāmi wa ahlih, thabbitnī bihi ḥattā alqāk.
supplications.translation: O Allah, Guardian of Islam and its people, keep me firm in it until I meet You.
supplications.when_to_recite: When lost, confused, or in difficulty

supplications.title: Du'a of Yunus — Relief from Distress
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.
supplications.translation: There is no deity but You; glory be to You. Indeed I have been of the wrongdoers.
supplications.when_to_recite: In any distress — no Muslim recites this in difficulty except that Allah answers

supplications.title: Du'a Upon Receiving Bad News or Calamity
supplications.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
supplications.transliteration: Innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rāji'ūn. Allāhumma'jurnī fī muṣībatī wa akhlif lī khayran minhā.
supplications.translation: We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me in my calamity and replace it with something better.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon any affliction, loss, or calamity — whoever says this, Allah will replace what was lost with something better

supplications.title: Du'a for Relief from Debt
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummakfinī biḥalālika 'an ḥarāmika wa aghnini bifaḍlika 'amman siwāk.
supplications.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful, away from what You have made unlawful, and make me independent of all others besides You.
supplications.when_to_recite: When in debt or financial hardship

supplications.title: Du'a of Ayyub — Affliction and Mercy
supplications.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Annī massaniyadh-dhurru wa anta arḥamur-rāḥimīn.
supplications.translation: Adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
supplications.when_to_recite: When suffering illness, pain, or prolonged hardship; du'a of Ayyub alayhis salam

supplications.title: Comprehensive Du'a in Difficulty
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū falā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata 'aynin wa aṣliḥ lī sha'nī kullahu lā ilāha illā ant.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye. Set right all my affairs. There is no deity but You.
supplications.when_to_recite: In any state of difficulty or worry

supplications.title: Du'a When Afraid
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-hammi wal-ḥazan.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief.
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling fear, anxiety, or grief

supplications.title: Du'a When Feeling Overwhelmed
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانتَصِرْ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi innī maghiūbun fantaṣir.
supplications.translation: My Lord, I am overpowered, so help me.
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling overwhelmed, helpless, or overpowered — du'a of Nuh alayhis salam

supplications.title: Du'a When Facing Oppression
supplications.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
supplications.transliteration: Ḥasbunallāhu wa ni'mal-wakīl.
supplications.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
supplications.when_to_recite: When facing oppression, injustice, or an enemy — words of Ibrahim alayhis salam when thrown into the fire; Allah made the fire cool

supplications.title: Du'a for Ease — Nothing Is Easy Except by Allah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma lā sahla illā mā ja'altahu sahlā wa anta taj'alul-ḥazna idhā shi'ta sahlā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy when You will.
supplications.when_to_recite: When facing any difficulty

supplications.title: Du'a When the Heart Is Heavy
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī 'abduka wabnu 'abdika wabnu amatika nāṣiyatī biyadika māḍin fiyya ḥukmuka 'adlun fiyya qaḍā'uk.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your servant, the son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand. Your judgement is carried out upon me, Your decree is just for me.
supplications.when_to_recite: When deeply distressed — part of the complete du'a in which Allah promises to replace sadness with joy

supplications.title: Complete Du'a for Removing Grief
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي وَنُورَ صَدْرِي وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī 'abduka bnu 'abdika bnu amatika nāṣiyatī biyadika māḍin fiyya ḥukmuka 'adlun fiyya qaḍā'uka as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka sammayta bihi nafsaka aw anzaltahu fī kitābika aw 'allamtahu aḥadan min khalqika awista'tharta bihi fī 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indaka an taj'alal-qur'āna rabī'a qalbī wa nūra ṣadrī wa jalā'a ḥuznī wa dhahāba hammī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand. Your command over me is forever executed, Your decree is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours — by which You have named Yourself, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to one of Your creation, or kept in the knowledge of the unseen — to make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the departure of my sorrow, and the vanishing of my grief.
supplications.when_to_recite: When in deep grief — Allah will replace grief with joy and worry with peace

supplications.title: Du'a of Complete Tawakkul
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma 'alayka tawakkaltu wa ilayka anabt u wa bika khāṣamtu wa ilayka ḥākamt.
supplications.translation: O Allah, in You I place my trust, to You I turn in repentance, with Your help I argue, and to You I submit for judgment.
supplications.when_to_recite: When surrendering one's affairs to Allah

supplications.title: Du'a When Visiting the Sick
supplications.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ba'sa ṭahūrun in shā'allāh.
supplications.translation: Do not worry, it is a purification, if Allah wills.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said when visiting someone who is ill — illness purifies from sins

supplications.title: Du'a for the Sick — Said 7 Times
supplications.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
supplications.transliteration: As'alullāhal-'aẓīma rabbal-'arshil-'aẓīmi an yashfiyak.
supplications.translation: I ask Allah the Magnificent, the Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to cure you.
supplications.when_to_recite: Seven times when visiting a sick person who is not at the point of death — guaranteed healing if recovery is decreed

supplications.title: Du'a When Sick Yourself — Ruqya
