supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāhi arqīka min kulli shay'in yu'dhīka min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'ayni ḥāsidin Allāhu yashfīka bismillāhi arqīk.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you, from every thing that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye — Allah heals you. In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you.
supplications.when_to_recite: Ruqya — said over a sick person while placing the right hand on them

supplications.title: Du'a for Pain in the Body
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (×٣) أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāh (×3). A'ūdhu billāhi wa qudratihī min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah (×3). I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
supplications.when_to_recite: Place your hand on the place of pain and say Bismillah 3 times, then the du'a 7 times

supplications.title: Du'a for Someone at the Point of Death
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī warḥamnī wa alḥiqnī bir-rafīqil-a'lā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, and unite me with the highest companion (the Prophet ﷺ).
supplications.when_to_recite: Said by the Prophet ﷺ at the time of death; encourage the dying to recite it or say it for them

supplications.title: Talqin — Guiding the Dying to Say La Ilaha Illallah
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh.
supplications.translation: There is no deity but Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: Encourage the dying person to say this — the Prophet ﷺ said whoever's last words are this enters Paradise

supplications.title: Rabbana — Accept from Us (Ibrahim & Ismail)
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā taqabbal minnā innaka antas-samī'ul-'alīm.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
supplications.when_to_recite: After any act of worship

supplications.title: Rabbana — Good in This World and the Next
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā 'adhāban-nār.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
supplications.when_to_recite: The most comprehensive du'a — between the Yemeni Corner and Black Stone during Tawaf; at all times

supplications.title: Rabbana — Grant Patience and Victory
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā afrigh 'alaynā ṣabran wa thabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā 'alal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
supplications.when_to_recite: When facing trials, oppression, or seeking steadfastness

supplications.title: Rabbana — Last Two Ayat of Al-Baqara
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tu'ākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭa'nā. Rabbanā wa lā taḥmil 'alaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahu 'alal-ladhīna min qablinā. Rabbanā wa lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih. Wa'fu 'annā waghfir lanā warḥamnā anta mawlānā fanṣurnā 'alal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we forget or make an error. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us, and forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
supplications.when_to_recite: Every night before sleeping — these two ayat suffice a person

supplications.title: Rabbana — Do Not Let Our Hearts Deviate
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā ba'da idh hadaytanā wa hab lanā milladunka raḥmatan innaka antal-Wahhāb.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
supplications.when_to_recite: When fearing going astray or when heart is unsettled

supplications.title: Rabbana — Forgive Our Sins and Save Us from Fire
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā innanā āmannā faghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa qinā 'adhāban-nār.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
supplications.when_to_recite: A fundamental du'a — belief + seeking forgiveness + protection from hellfire

supplications.title: Rabbana — Grant Me Righteous Offspring (Zakariyya)
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī milladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibatan innaka samī'ud-du'ā'.
supplications.translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
supplications.when_to_recite: When asking for righteous children; du'a of Zakariyya alayhis salam

supplications.title: Rabbana — Make Us Among the Witnesses
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wattaba'nar-rasūla faktubna ma'ash-shāhidīn.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger, so register us among the witnesses.
supplications.when_to_recite: Affirming faith and asking to be counted among those who testify to truth

supplications.title: Rabbana — Forgive, Establish Our Feet, Give Victory
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanāghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa isrāfanā fī amrinā wa thabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā 'alal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
supplications.when_to_recite: In times of trial, conflict, or when seeking steadfastness

supplications.title: Rabbana — Protect Us from the Fire (Ulu al-Albab)
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilan subḥānaka faqinā 'adhāban-nār.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, You did not create this without purpose; glory be to You! Protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
supplications.when_to_recite: When reflecting on the creation — the du'a of the people of understanding (Ulu al-Albab)

supplications.title: Rabbana — Forgive Sins and Enter Us into Paradise
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā faghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa kaffir 'annā sayyi'ātinā wa tawaffanā ma'al-abrār.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.
supplications.when_to_recite: Seeking complete forgiveness and a righteous death

supplications.title: Rabbana — Grant What You Promised and Honor Us
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā wa ātinā mā wa'adtanā 'alā rusulika wa lā tukhzinā yawmal-qiyāmah, innaka lā tukhlifu'l-mī'ād.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.
supplications.when_to_recite: Asking Allah to fulfil His promise to the believers

supplications.title: Rabbana — We Have Wronged Ourselves (Adam's Du'a)
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa illam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā lanakūnanna minal-khāsirīn.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
supplications.when_to_recite: When repenting from sin — the du'a of Adam and Hawwa alayhima as-salam

supplications.title: Rabbana — Do Not Make Us a Trial for the Oppressors
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā lā taj'alnā fitnatan lil-qawmiẓ-ẓālimīna wa najjinā biraḥmatika minal-qawmil-kāfirīn.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
supplications.when_to_recite: When in a land of oppression or when Muslims are being persecuted

supplications.title: Rabbana — Make Me a Keeper of Prayer
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbij'alnī muqīmaṣ-ṣalāti wa min dhurriyyatī rabbanā wa taqabbal du'ā'. Rabbanāghfir lī wa liwālidayya wa lil-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmul-ḥisāb.
supplications.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication. Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of Ibrahim alayhis salam — asking for prayer, offspring, forgiveness

supplications.title: Rabbana — Open My Chest (Musa's Du'a)
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
supplications.transliteration: Rabbish-raḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī waḥlul 'uqdatan min lisānī yafqahū qawlī.
supplications.translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest and ease my task for me and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before any important speech, teaching, or task

supplications.title: Du'a of Yunus — In the Whale's Belly
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.
supplications.translation: There is no deity but You; glory be to You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
supplications.when_to_recite: In any distress — Allah answered Yunus alayhis salam and He answers all who call with this

supplications.title: Du'a of Ayyub — Adversity Has Touched Me
supplications.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Annī massaniyadh-dhurru wa anta arḥamur-rāḥimīn.
supplications.translation: Adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
supplications.when_to_recite: When suffering illness or prolonged hardship — du'a of Ayyub alayhis salam

supplications.title: Du'a of Zakariyya — Do Not Leave Me Alone
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi lā tadharni fardan wa anta khayrul-wārithīn.
supplications.translation: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors.
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling alone or asking for a child; du'a of Zakariyya alayhis salam

supplications.title: Du'a of Nuh — Forgive Me and My Parents
supplications.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbighfir lī wa liwālidayya wa liman dakhala baytī mu'minan wa lil-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināt.
supplications.translation: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, whoever enters my house as a believer, and all believing men and women.
supplications.when_to_recite: When asking comprehensive forgiveness for family and the believing community

supplications.title: Du'a of Sulaiman — Gratitude for Blessing
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nī an ashkura ni'matakallatī an'amta 'alayya wa 'alā wālidayya wa an a'mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa adkhilnī biraḥmatika fī 'ibādikaṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
supplications.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of Sulaiman and the righteous — asking for gratitude and a righteous end

supplications.title: Du'a for Forgiveness for Parents (Ibrahim)
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanāghfir lī wa liwālidayya wa lil-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmul-ḥisāb.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying for forgiveness for oneself, parents, and all believers

supplications.title: Rabbana — Make Us Leaders of the Righteous
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata a'yunin waj'alnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous.
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying for a righteous family and to be a model of righteousness

supplications.title: Du'a — Enter Me Honorably and Exit Honorably
supplications.arabic: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnī mudkhala ṣidqin wa akhrijnī mukhraja ṣidqin waj'al lī milladunka sulṭānan naṣīrā.
supplications.translation: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.
supplications.when_to_recite: When entering a new situation, city, job, or phase of life

supplications.title: Du'a for Mercy and Right Guidance
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā milladunka raḥmatan wa hayyi' lanā min amrinā rashadā.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking Allah's mercy and guidance in one's affairs — du'a of the companions of the cave

supplications.title: Du'a — Increase Me in Knowledge
supplications.arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi zidnī 'ilmā.
supplications.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before study and any pursuit of knowledge

supplications.title: Rabbana — Our Lord You Are All-Knowing
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā 'alayka tawakkalnā wa ilayka anabnā wa ilaykal-maṣīr.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
supplications.when_to_recite: When placing complete trust in Allah and returning to Him

supplications.title: Du'a — Last Three Ayat of Surah Al-Hashr
supplications.arabic: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Huwa Allāhulladhī lā ilāha illā huwa, 'ālimu l-ghaybi wash-shahādah, huwa r-Raḥmānu r-Raḥīm...
supplications.translation: Recite the last 3 ayat of Surah Al-Hashr (59:22-24) — whoever recites them in the morning, 70,000 angels pray for them until evening and vice versa.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — Surah Al-Hashr 59:22-24

supplications.title: Al-Fatiha — Opening of the Quran
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
supplications.transliteration: Alḥamdulillāhi rabbil-'ālamīn, ar-raḥmānir-raḥīm, māliki yawmid-dīn. Iyyāka na'budu wa iyyāka nasta'īn. Ihdinaṣ-ṣirāṭal-mustaqīm.
supplications.translation: All praise is for Allah, Lord of all worlds, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful, Master of the Day of Judgment. You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path.
supplications.when_to_recite: In every unit of every prayer — the greatest surah in the Quran; can be recited as ruqya

supplications.title: Last Two Ayat of Al-Baqara — Nightly Recitation
supplications.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Āmanar-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minūna kullun āmana billāhi wa malā'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih...
supplications.translation: Recite the last two ayat of Surah Al-Baqara (2:285-286) — they suffice whoever recites them at night.
supplications.when_to_recite: Every night before sleeping

supplications.title: Du'a at Age Forty — Gratitude and Righteousness
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nī an ashkura ni'matakallatī an'amta 'alayya wa 'alā wālidayya wa an a'mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī.
supplications.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve, and make righteous for me my offspring.
supplications.when_to_recite: Especially at age forty — the most comprehensive du'a for gratitude, righteousness, and family

supplications.title: Three Istighfar After Prayer
supplications.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
supplications.transliteration: Astaghfirullāh, Astaghfirullāh, Astaghfirullāh.
supplications.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah. I seek forgiveness from Allah. I seek forgiveness from Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times after every obligatory prayer

supplications.title: Istighfar 100 Times Daily
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbighfir lī wa tub 'alayya innaka anta t-Tawwābur-Raḥīm.
supplications.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. Indeed You are the Ever-Accepting of Repentance, the Most Merciful.
supplications.when_to_recite: The Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness 100 times a day — a model for all of us

supplications.title: Seeking Forgiveness by Tahlil
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ أَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, atūbu ilayh.
supplications.translation: There is no deity but Allah alone, with no partner. I repent to Him.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking repentance with tawbah (turning back to Allah)

supplications.title: Du'a for Sincere Repentance (Tawbah Nasooh)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُهُ عَمْدًا أَوْ خَطَأً سِرًّا أَوْ عَلَانِيَةً
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī atūbu ilayka min kulli dhanbin adhnabtuhu 'amdan aw khata'an sirran aw 'alāniyah.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I repent to You from every sin I have committed — intentionally or by mistake, secretly or openly.
supplications.when_to_recite: When making sincere comprehensive repentance
supplications.source: Based on prophetic teachings on tawbah

supplications.title: Do Not Despair of Allah's Mercy
supplications.arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا
supplications.transliteration: Qul yā 'ibādiyalladhīna asrafū 'alā anfusihim lā taqnaṭū min raḥmatillāh, innallāha yaghfirudh-dhunūba jamī'ā.
supplications.translation: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves — do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling overwhelmed by sins — a reminder from Allah Himself

supplications.title: Du'a for Forgiveness of the Day's Sins
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī mā qaddamtu wa mā akhkhartu wa mā asrartu wa mā a'lantu wa mā asraftu wa mā anta a'lamu bihi minnī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive me what I have done before and what I have deferred, what I have concealed and what I have revealed, the excess I have committed, and what You know of me better than I do.
supplications.when_to_recite: A comprehensive seeking of forgiveness covering all types of sins

supplications.title: Those Who Remember Allah and Seek Forgiveness
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanāghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa isrāfanā fī amrinā.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs.
supplications.when_to_recite: When repenting from any form of excess or transgression

supplications.title: Du'a for Forgiveness — Nights of Power
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka 'afuwwun tuḥibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'annī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are Most Forgiving, and You love to forgive, so forgive me.
supplications.when_to_recite: On the last 10 nights of Ramadan; and at all times

supplications.title: Seeking Forgiveness in Prostration
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
supplications.transliteration: SubḥānakAllāhumma rabbanā wa biḥamdika Allāhummaghfir lī.
supplications.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise be to You. O Allah, forgive me.
supplications.when_to_recite: During prostration (sujud) — the Prophet ﷺ recited this frequently in ruku and sujud

supplications.title: Al-Fatiha as Ruqya for Illness
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ...
supplications.transliteration: Recite Surah Al-Fatiha (7 times) over the sick person or the place of pain.
supplications.translation: Recite Al-Fatiha 7 times over the ill person — the Companions used this to cure someone bitten by a scorpion

supplications.title: Six Verses of Healing from the Quran
supplications.arabic: وَيَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُّؤْمِنِينَ
supplications.transliteration: The six 'shifa' verses: 9:14, 10:57, 16:69, 17:82, 26:80, 41:44 — recite all for healing.
supplications.translation: Six Quranic verses that contain the word 'shifa' (healing) — reciting them is a sunnah-based ruqya for illness.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking healing — ruqya with Quranic verses of healing
supplications.source: Based on Quran and scholarly practice

supplications.title: Du'a When Visiting the Sick
supplications.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
supplications.transliteration: As'alullāhal-'aẓīma rabbal-'arshil-'aẓīmi an yashfiyak.
supplications.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to cure you.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said seven times when visiting a sick Muslim — whoever says it and recovery is decreed, it will be their cure

supplications.title: Du'a for Physical Pain
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu billāhi wa qudratihī min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
supplications.when_to_recite: Place the right hand on the painful area — say Bismillah 3 times, then this du'a 7 times

supplications.title: Du'a for Peace of Mind and Heart
supplications.arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
supplications.transliteration: Alā bidhikrillāhi taṭma'innul-qulūb.
supplications.translation: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
supplications.when_to_recite: A reminder and du'a when the heart is troubled — repeat frequently

supplications.title: Du'a for Protection of Sight
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنِي بِسَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَاجْعَلْهُمَا الْوَارِثَ مِنِّي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma matti'nī bism'ī wa baṣarī waj'alhumāl-wāritha minnī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, let me enjoy my hearing and sight and make them inherit from me.
supplications.when_to_recite: Asking Allah to preserve hearing and sight until the end of life

supplications.title: Du'a During Fever
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْكَبِيرِ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ عِرْقٍ نَعَّارٍ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَرِّ النَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāhil-kabīri a'ūdhu billāhil-'aẓīmi min sharri kulli 'irqin na''ārin wa min sharri ḥarrin-nār.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah the Great, I seek refuge in Allah the Mighty from the evil of every throbbing vein and from the evil of the heat of the fire.
supplications.when_to_recite: During fever — place the right hand on the forehead and say

supplications.title: Du'a for Quran Memorization
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي بِتَرْكِ مَعَاصِيكَ مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي وَارْحَمْنِي أَنْ أَتَكَلَّفَ مَا لَا يَعْنِينِي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummarḥamnī bitarki ma'āṣīka mā abqaytanī warḥamnī an atakallafa mā lā ya'nīnī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, have mercy on me through leaving Your disobedience for as long as You keep me alive, and have mercy on me by not burdening me with what does not concern me.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking focus in worship and knowledge

supplications.title: Du'a Before Studying or Learning
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummanfa'nī bimā 'allamtanī wa 'allimnī mā yanfa'unī wa zidnī 'ilmā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before any study session or learning

supplications.title: Du'a for Understanding — Comprehension
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
supplications.transliteration: Rabbish-raḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī.
supplications.translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest and ease my task for me.
supplications.when_to_recite: When finding something difficult to understand or learn

supplications.title: Du'a of a Teacher Before Teaching
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَلِّمْنَا مَا يَنْفَعُنَا وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma 'allim nā mā yanfa'unā wanfa'nā bimā 'allamtanā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, teach us what will benefit us, and benefit us with what You have taught us.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before teaching a class, lesson, or sharing knowledge

supplications.title: Du'a for Wisdom (Hikmah)
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī ḥukman wa alḥiqnī biṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
supplications.translation: My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of Ibrahim alayhis salam — asking for wisdom and righteous companionship

supplications.title: Du'a for Protection from Ignorance
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْبُخْلِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-jubni wal-harami wal-bukhl.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from weakness, laziness, cowardice, old age (senility), and miserliness.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — protecting against the traits that block beneficial action

supplications.title: Protection from Jinn and Evil
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
supplications.when_to_recite: Three times in the evening — nothing harmful will touch whoever says this until morning

supplications.title: Protection from Envy and the Evil Eye
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min zawāli ni'matika wa taḥawwuli 'āfiyatika wa fujā'ati niqmatika wa jamī'i sakhaṭik.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the removal of Your blessing, the change of Your protection, the sudden onset of Your punishment, and all of Your displeasure.
supplications.when_to_recite: When enjoying a blessing — protecting it from being taken away

supplications.title: Daily Protection from Shaytan
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu billāhis-samī'il-'alīmi minash-shayṭānir-rajīmi min hamzihi wa nafkhihi wa nafthih.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Shaytan — from his incitement, his pride, and his poetry.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before prayer — after the opening takbeer

supplications.title: Protection from Harm by Others
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innā naj'aluka fī nuḥūrihim wa na'ūdhu bika min shurūrihim.
supplications.translation: O Allah, we place You before them and seek refuge in You from their evils.
supplications.when_to_recite: When fearing harm from enemies or oppressive people

supplications.title: Protection from Plague and Epidemic
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الأَسْقَامِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-baraṣi wal-junūni wal-judhāmi wa min sayyi'il-asqām.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy, madness, elephantiasis, and from the worst of illnesses.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning protection adhkar — said every morning

supplications.title: Protection from the Dajjal
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min 'adhābi jahannama wa min 'adhābil-qabri wa min fitnatil-maḥyā wal-mamāti wa min sharri fitnatil-masīḥid-dajjāl.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hellfire, from the punishment of the grave, from the trial of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah.
supplications.when_to_recite: In the last tashahhud before salam in every prayer — the Prophet ﷺ commanded this

supplications.title: Protection from Bad Character Traits
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشُّحِّ وَالْجُبْنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minash-shuḥḥi wal-jubni wa a'ūdhu bika an uradda ilā ardhali'l-'umuri wa a'ūdhu bika min fitnatid-dunyā wa 'adhābil-qabr.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness and cowardice, and I seek refuge in You from being returned to the worst of old age, and I seek refuge in You from the trial of this world and the punishment of the grave.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening adhkar

supplications.title: Seeking Refuge from Four Great Evils
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqri wa 'adhābil-qabr.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief, poverty, and the punishment of the grave.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening protection

supplications.title: When Seeing Something Beautiful You Fear Evil Eye For
supplications.arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Mā shā'allāhu lā quwwata illā billāh.
supplications.translation: What Allah wills — there is no power except with Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeing something you love and fear the evil eye for — protect it by saying this

supplications.title: Ruqya for Children — As the Prophet Said
supplications.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
supplications.transliteration: U'īdhukumā bikalimātillāhit-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmatin wa min kulli 'aynin lāmmah.
supplications.translation: I seek Allah's protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every creature, and from every envious eye.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said over children by a parent — the du'a the Prophet ﷺ used for Hasan and Husayn

supplications.title: Closing Doors at Night for Protection
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَأَغْلِقُوا أَبْوَابَكُمْ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāhi wa aghliqū abwābakum.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah — [and close your doors].
supplications.when_to_recite: Said before closing the door at night — Shaytan does not open a closed door that was shut with Bismillah

supplications.title: Covering Food and Drink at Night
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāh.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah — [cover your vessels].
supplications.when_to_recite: Said when covering food and drink at night — even placing something across the vessel is sufficient

supplications.title: Du'a for a Newborn Baby
supplications.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fil-mawhūbi lak, wa shakarta l-Wāhib, wa balagha ashuddahu wa ruziqta birrah.
supplications.translation: May Allah bless you in the gift given to you. May you give thanks to the Giver, may the child reach maturity, and may you be granted its righteousness.
supplications.when_to_recite: When congratulating someone on the birth of a child

supplications.title: Du'a for Love and Mercy in Marriage
supplications.arabic: وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
supplications.transliteration: Wa ja'ala baynakum mawaddatan wa raḥmah.
supplications.translation: And He placed between you affection and mercy.
supplications.when_to_recite: A reminder of Allah's gift in marriage — recite and reflect; ask Allah to strengthen these

supplications.title: Du'a When Caring for Those in Need
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنْ يُعِينُ الضَّعِيفَ وَيَكْفُلُ الْيَتِيمَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaj'alnī mimman yu'īnu'ḍ-ḍa'īfa wa yakfulu'l-yatīm.
supplications.translation: O Allah, make me among those who support the weak and care for the orphan.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking to be a source of good for others
supplications.source: Based on prophetic teachings on caring for orphans

supplications.title: Du'a for Living Parents
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbir-ḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā.
supplications.translation: My Lord, have mercy on them both, as they raised me when I was small.
supplications.when_to_recite: For living parents — the greatest act of filial piety after obedience

supplications.title: Du'a for Brothers and Sisters in Faith
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالإِيمَانِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir li-ikhwāninālladhīna sabaqūnā bil-īmān.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith.
supplications.when_to_recite: When making du'a for fellow Muslims — the du'a of the righteous believers in Quran

supplications.title: Du'a for Finding a Good Spouse
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.
supplications.translation: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking a righteous spouse — du'a of Musa alayhis salam after helping the women

supplications.title: Du'a When Separated from Family
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آنِسْ وَحْشَتِي فِي سَفَرِي وَاخْلُفْنِي فِي أَهْلِي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ānis waḥshatī fī safarī wakhlufnī fī ahlī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, comfort my loneliness in my travel and be a guardian to my family in my absence.
supplications.when_to_recite: When separated from family — said by the Prophet ﷺ when departing for journeys

supplications.title: Du'a for One's Teachers and Mentors
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِمَشَايِخِنَا وَلِمَنْ عَلَّمَنَا وَرَبَّانَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir limashāyikhinā wa liman 'allamanā wa rabbanā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive our teachers and those who educated and raised us.
supplications.when_to_recite: When making du'a for those who shaped your knowledge and character

supplications.title: Du'a to Die with the Righteous
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī ḥukman wa alḥiqnī biṣ-ṣāliḥīna waj'al lī lisāna ṣidqin fil-ākhirīn.
supplications.translation: My Lord, grant me wisdom, join me with the righteous, and give me a truthful reputation among future generations.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of Ibrahim alayhis salam — asking to be among the righteous and remembered well

supplications.title: Du'a for Opening and Ease — Al-Fath
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma lā māni'a limā a'ṭayta wa lā mu'ṭiya limā mana'ta wa lā yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
supplications.translation: O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and the wealth of the wealthy person will not benefit them from You.
supplications.when_to_recite: After every obligatory prayer — said after the tasbih

supplications.title: Du'a Before an Important Matter or Interview
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي وَاهْدِنِي لِمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma waffiqnī wa saddidnī wahdinī limā tuḥibbu wa tarḍā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, grant me success, keep me upright, and guide me to what You love and are pleased with.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before interviews, important meetings, or any significant undertaking

supplications.title: Morning Du'a for Provision
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقًا وَاسِعًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka rizqan wāsi'an ṭayyiban mubārakan.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for abundant, pure, and blessed provision.
supplications.when_to_recite: In the morning — seek provision early; rizq is spread in the morning hours

supplications.title: Du'a for Barakah in Business and Trade
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي بَيْعِي وَشِرَائِي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lī fī bay'ī wa shirā'ī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, bless me in my buying and selling.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before conducting business, trade, or any financial transaction
supplications.source: Based on prophetic teachings on halal trade

supplications.title: Comprehensive Success Du'a — Prophet's Teaching
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَآخِرَتِي وَأَعِنِّي عَلَى مَا يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَيْكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma aṣliḥ lī dīnī wa dunyāya wa ākhiratī wa a'innī 'alā mā yuqarribunī ilayk.
supplications.translation: O Allah, set right my religion, my worldly life, and my hereafter, and help me in what brings me closer to You.
supplications.when_to_recite: A comprehensive daily supplication for all aspects of life

supplications.title: Du'a Before an Exam or Test
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي
supplications.transliteration: Rabbish-raḥ lī ṣadrī wa yassir lī amrī waḥlul 'uqdatan min lisānī.
supplications.translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest, ease my task for me, and untie the knot from my tongue.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before examinations, presentations, or any test of skill or knowledge

supplications.title: Du'a of Gratitude for a Blessing Received
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
supplications.transliteration: Alḥamdulillāhilladhī bini'matihi tatimmuṣ-ṣāliḥāt.
supplications.translation: All praise is for Allah by whose blessing good deeds are completed.
supplications.when_to_recite: When a good thing happens, a blessing is received, or a goal is achieved

supplications.title: Du'a on the First Night of Marriage
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāh, Allāhumma jannibnash-shayṭāna wa jannibish-shayṭāna mā razaqtanā.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Shaytan away from us and keep Shaytan away from what You bless us with.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before intimacy — any child conceived will be protected from Shaytan's harm

supplications.title: Du'a at a Wedding Feast
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma aṭ'im man aṭ'amanī wasqi man saqānī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, feed the one who fed me and give drink to the one who gave me drink.
supplications.when_to_recite: When hosted at a walimah or any feast — du'a for the host

supplications.title: Du'a When Taking the Hand of a New Spouse
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra mā jabaltahā 'alayhi wa a'ūdhu bika min sharrihā wa min sharri mā jabaltahā 'alayh.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good in her and the good of her natural character, and I seek refuge from her evil and the evil of her natural character.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said by the husband when first meeting his new wife — places forehead gently and says this

supplications.title: Du'a During Marital Conflict
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma allif bayna qulūbinā wa aṣliḥ dhāta bayninā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, unite our hearts and set our affairs right between us.
supplications.when_to_recite: When experiencing friction or disagreement with a spouse
supplications.source: Based on prophetic du'as for reconciliation

supplications.title: Du'a for a Widow or Widower
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma'jurnī fī muṣībatī wa akhlif lī khayran minhā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, reward me in my calamity and replace it with something better.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon the loss of a spouse — for whoever says this with sincerity, Allah replaces with something better

supplications.title: Du'a for the Couple (Said by Guests)
supplications.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكُمَا وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكُمَا وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
supplications.transliteration: Bārakallāhu lakumā wa bāraka 'alaykumā wa jama'a baynakumā fī khayr.
supplications.translation: May Allah bless you both, bestow His blessings upon you both, and unite you both in goodness.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said to the married couple — the sunnah greeting for a wedding

supplications.title: Du'a for the Scholars of Islam
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ عُلَمَاءَنَا وَاجْعَلْهُمْ هُدَاةً مَهْدِيِّينَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma aṣliḥ 'ulamā'anā waj'alhum hudātan mahdiyyīn.
supplications.translation: O Allah, rectify our scholars and make them guided guides.
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying for the preservation of authentic Islamic knowledge

supplications.title: Du'a for Muslim Prisoners
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فُكَّ أَسْرَ الْمَأْسُورِينَ وَاهْدِ ضَالَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma fukka asral-ma'sūrīna wahdi ḍāllal-muslimīn.
supplications.translation: O Allah, free the captive Muslims and guide the straying Muslims.
supplications.when_to_recite: When making du'a for imprisoned and lost Muslims worldwide
supplications.source: Based on prophetic teachings on brotherhood

supplications.title: Du'a for Muslims Suffering Illness Worldwide
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِ مَرْضَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَارْحَمْ مَوْتَاهُمْ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ishfi marḍal-muslimīna warḥam mawtāhum.
supplications.translation: O Allah, heal the sick Muslims and have mercy on their deceased.
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying for ill and deceased Muslims globally
supplications.source: Based on general du'as from Sunnah

supplications.title: Du'a for the Future Generations of Muslims
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ شَبَابَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَاجْعَلْهُمْ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma aṣliḥ shabābal-muslimīna waj'alhum minas-ṣāliḥīn.
supplications.translation: O Allah, rectify the Muslim youth and make them among the righteous.
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying for Muslim youth and the next generation
supplications.source: Based on prophetic concern for generations to come

supplications.title: Du'a for Muslims in Need and Displaced
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آوِ كُلَّ مُسْلِمٍ مُشَرَّدٍ وَأَطْعِمْ كُلَّ مُسْلِمٍ جَائِعٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma āwi kulla muslimin musharridin wa aṭ'im kulla muslimin jā'i'.
supplications.translation: O Allah, shelter every displaced Muslim and feed every hungry Muslim.
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying for refugees, displaced peoples, and the hungry
supplications.source: Based on prophetic concern for the poor and needy

supplications.title: Du'a for Protection from Internal Fitnah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا نَعْلَمُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا نَعْلَمُهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innā na'ūdhu bika an nushrika bika shay'an na'lamahu wa nastaghfiruka limā lā na'lamuh.
supplications.translation: O Allah, we seek refuge in You from knowingly associating partners with You, and we seek Your forgiveness for what we do not know.
supplications.when_to_recite: Protection from shirk and internal corruption of the Ummah

supplications.title: Alhamdulillah — The Comprehensive Praise
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
supplications.transliteration: Alḥamdulillāhi 'alā kulli ḥāl.
supplications.translation: All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.
supplications.when_to_recite: In all situations — good and bad — as a recognition that all comes from Allah

supplications.title: Du'a of Gratitude for a Specific Blessing
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma lakal-ḥamdu wa lakash-shukr.
supplications.translation: O Allah, to You is all praise and to You is all gratitude.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon receiving any blessing — the minimum gratitude due to Allah
supplications.source: Based on comprehensive hadiths on shukr

supplications.title: Sealing Du'a with Salawat and Ameen
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءَنَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli 'alā Muḥammadin wa taqabbal du'ā'anā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and accept our supplication.
supplications.when_to_recite: At the end of every du'a — open with praise of Allah, send salawat, then make du'a, then close with salawat
supplications.source: Based on hadith: du'a is suspended until salawat is sent

supplications.title: Du'a at the End of Ramadan
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا صِيَامَنَا وَقِيَامَنَا وَرُكُوعَنَا وَسُجُودَنَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma taqabbal minnā ṣiyāmanā wa qiyāmanā wa rukū'anā wa sujūdanā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, accept our fasting, our night prayer, our bowing, and our prostration.
supplications.when_to_recite: At the end of Ramadan — asking Allah to accept the month's worship
supplications.source: Based on the du'a of Ibrahim alayhis salam (Quran 2:127)

supplications.title: Du'a Upon Receiving Good News
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
supplications.transliteration: Alḥamdulillāhilladhī bini'matihi tatimmuṣ-ṣāliḥāt.
supplications.translation: All praise is for Allah, by whose blessing good deeds are completed.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon receiving good news or when something goes well

supplications.title: Du'a on Eid — Greeting
supplications.arabic: تَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنَّا وَمِنكُمْ
supplications.transliteration: Taqabbalallāhu minnā wa minkum.
supplications.translation: May Allah accept from us and from you.
supplications.when_to_recite: The greeting exchanged between Muslims on Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
supplications.source: Fath al-Bari — practice of the companions

supplications.title: Du'a After Completing Any Act of Worship
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
supplications.transliteration: Subḥānakallāhumma wa biḥamdika ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā anta astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk.
supplications.translation: Glory be to You O Allah and with Your praise; I bear witness that there is no deity but You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
supplications.when_to_recite: At the end of any gathering, study circle, or worship — expiation for any sins of that session

supplications.title: Du'a When Preparing the Body for Burial
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummarfa' darajatahu fil-mahdiyyīna wakhlufhu fī 'aqibihi fil-ghābirīna waghfir lanā wa lahu yā rabbal-'ālamīn.
supplications.translation: O Allah, raise his rank among the rightly guided and be a guardian to those he leaves behind, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a for the deceased person being prepared for burial

supplications.title: Du'a When Lowering the Deceased into the Grave
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāhi wa 'alā millati rasūlillāh.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah and upon the way of the Messenger of Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said by those lowering the body into the grave

supplications.title: Du'a After Burying the Deceased
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lah. Allāhumma thabbit-h.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, make him firm.
supplications.when_to_recite: After the burial is complete — the Prophet ﷺ would stand and say: ask forgiveness for your brother and ask for his steadfastness

supplications.title: Du'a When Giving Sadaqah for the Deceased
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ ثَوَابَ هَذَا لِرُوحِ فُلَانٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaj'al thawāba hādhā li-rūḥi fulān.
supplications.translation: O Allah, make the reward of this for the soul of [name of deceased].
supplications.when_to_recite: When giving charity on behalf of a deceased person — charity, du'a, and Hajj benefit the dead

supplications.title: Du'a When Dreaming of the Deceased
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلَهُ وَأَعْقِبْنِي مِنْهُ عُقْبَى حَسَنَةً
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī wa lahu wa a'qibnī minhu 'uqbā ḥasanah.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive me and him, and grant me a good outcome from him.
supplications.when_to_recite: When you see a deceased person in a dream — make du'a for them immediately upon waking
supplications.source: Based on prophetic guidance on dreams

supplications.title: Continuous Du'a for the Dead — Children's Duty
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir liwālidayya warḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive my parents and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
supplications.when_to_recite: The greatest ongoing gift a child can give deceased parents — say it daily after prayers

supplications.title: Du'a to Say to Grieving Family
supplications.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى وَكُلٌّ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ
supplications.transliteration: Inna lillāhi mā akhadha wa lahu mā a'ṭā wa kullun 'indahu bi-ajalin musamman, faltaṣbir waltaḥtasib.
supplications.translation: Indeed to Allah belongs what He took, and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed time — so be patient and seek Allah's reward.
supplications.when_to_recite: When offering condolences to the family of the deceased

supplications.title: Comprehensive Du'a — Five Requests
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'alukal-jannata wa mā qarraba ilayhā min qawlin aw 'amalin wa a'ūdhu bika minan-nāri wa mā qarraba ilayhā min qawlin aw 'amal.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever brings one closer to it of words or deeds, and I seek refuge in You from the Fire and whatever brings one closer to it of words or deeds.
supplications.when_to_recite: A comprehensive du'a covering Paradise and protection from Hellfire

supplications.title: The Beloved Words to Allah
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
supplications.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi walḥamdulillāhi wa lā ilāha illallāhu wallāhu akbar.
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no deity but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
supplications.when_to_recite: At any time — these four words are the most beloved to Allah. Saying all four equals filling the heavens and earth with good deeds

supplications.title: The Prophet's ﷺ Most Frequent Du'a
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā 'adhāban-nār.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
supplications.when_to_recite: The most frequently made du'a of the Prophet ﷺ — all-encompassing goodness of this world and the next

supplications.title: Du'a on Friday — Jumu'ah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik 'alā sayyidinā Muḥammad.
supplications.translation: O Allah, send your blessings, peace and grace upon our master Muhammad.
supplications.when_to_recite: Send abundant salawat on Fridays — Friday is the best day, and salawat are multiplied

supplications.title: Du'a in the Blessed Hour of Friday
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka bi-annaka anta Allāhu lā ilāha illā anta l-Aḥadu ṣ-Ṣamadu lladhī lam yalid wa lam yūlad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You by the fact that You are Allah — there is no deity but You, the One, the Eternal Refuge, who does not beget and was not begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.
supplications.when_to_recite: In the Friday blessed hour — du'a is answered in the hour on Friday near Asr

supplications.title: Opening Du'a of Tahajjud — Night Prayer
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma lakal-ḥamdu anta qayyimus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa man fīhinna wa lakal-ḥamdu laka mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa man fīhinn.
supplications.translation: O Allah, all praise is for You. You are the Sustainer of the heavens and earth and whoever is in them. All praise is for You; Yours is the dominion of the heavens and earth and whoever is in them.
supplications.when_to_recite: Opening of Tahajjud — the Prophet's ﷺ night prayer du'a

supplications.title: Comprehensive Ta'awwudh
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu billāhi minash-shayṭānir-rajīm.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before reciting Quran, before prayer, when angry, when lustful thoughts come — protection at all times

supplications.title: Bismillah — Starting with Allah's Name
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before every action — eating, writing, driving, beginning any task; what begins without Bismillah is cut off from barakah

supplications.title: Islamic Greeting — As-Salamu Alaykum
supplications.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
supplications.transliteration: As-salāmu 'alaykum wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh.
supplications.translation: Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah, and His blessings.
supplications.when_to_recite: When meeting any Muslim — spreading salaam is a right of the Muslim and a cause of love

supplications.title: Replying to Salaam
supplications.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
supplications.transliteration: Wa 'alaykumus-salāmu wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh.
supplications.translation: And upon you be peace, and the mercy of Allah, and His blessings.
supplications.when_to_recite: Replying to salaam — must be equal or better than the greeting given

supplications.title: Kaffarah al-Majlis — Closing of a Gathering
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
supplications.transliteration: SubḥānakAllāhumma wa biḥamdika ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā anta astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk.
supplications.translation: Glory be to You O Allah and with Your praise; I bear witness that there is no deity but You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
supplications.when_to_recite: At the end of any gathering — expiates whatever wrong was said in the sitting

supplications.title: Du'a for the Host Who Feeds You
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lahum fīmā razaqtahum waghfir lahum warḥamhum.
supplications.translation: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, forgive them, and have mercy on them.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said as a du'a for the host who has invited you to eat

supplications.title: Du'a When Visiting a Muslim Brother or Sister
supplications.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
supplications.transliteration: As'alullāhal-'aẓīma rabbal-'arshil-'aẓīmi an yashfiyak.
supplications.translation: I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to cure you.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said 7 times when visiting a sick Muslim — if recovery is possible, they will be cured

supplications.title: Thanking Someone for a Favour
supplications.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
supplications.transliteration: Jazākallāhu khayran.
supplications.translation: May Allah reward you with good.
supplications.when_to_recite: When someone does you a favour — the Prophet ﷺ said whoever says this has fully praised them

supplications.title: Du'a Upon Hearing Good News
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
supplications.transliteration: Alḥamdulillāhilladhī bini'matihi tatimmuṣ-ṣāliḥāt.
supplications.translation: All praise is for Allah, by whose blessing good deeds are completed.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon hearing good news

supplications.title: After Laughing — Return to Remembrance
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: SubḥānAllāh.
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: After laughing much — the Prophet ﷺ said: too much laughter kills the heart; return to dhikr

supplications.title: Du'a at the Start of Ramadan
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي رَجَبٍ وَشَعْبَانَ وَبَلِّغْنَا رَمَضَانَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fī Rajaba wa Sha'bāna wa ballighnā Ramaḍān.
supplications.translation: O Allah, bless us in Rajab and Sha'ban, and allow us to reach Ramadan.
supplications.when_to_recite: In Rajab and Sha'ban — asking to live to reach Ramadan

supplications.title: Du'a for Laylatul Qadr
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka 'afuwwun karīmun tuḥibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'annī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are Ever-Pardoning, Generous, and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
supplications.when_to_recite: Every night in the last 10 nights of Ramadan — specifically taught by the Prophet ﷺ for Laylatul Qadr

supplications.title: Du'a at Iftar — Breaking the Fast
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma laka ṣumtu wa 'alā rizqika afṭart.
supplications.translation: O Allah, for You I fasted and upon Your provision I break my fast.
supplications.when_to_recite: At the moment of breaking the fast at Maghrib

supplications.title: Du'a for Night of Power — Tahajjud
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ سِرِّي وَعَلَانِيَتِي فَاقْبَلْ مَعْذِرَتِي
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innaka ta'lamu sirrī wa 'alāniyatī faqbal ma'dhiratī.
supplications.translation: O Allah, You know my secrets and my open deeds, so accept my apology.
supplications.when_to_recite: In night prayers, asking Allah to accept repentance

supplications.title: Du'a When Giving Zakat or Sadaqah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا مَغْنَمًا وَلَا تَجْعَلْهَا مَغْرَمًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaj'alhā maghnanam wa lā taj'alhā maghramā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, make it a gain and do not make it a loss.
supplications.when_to_recite: When giving charity — asking for reward, not loss

supplications.title: Du'a to Attain Love of Allah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ وَحُبَّ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَى حُبِّكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka ḥubbaka wa ḥubba man yuḥibbuka wa ḥubba 'amalin yuqarribunī ilā ḥubbik.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and the love of deeds that bring me closer to Your love.
supplications.when_to_recite: Seeking the love of Allah — the Prophet ﷺ taught this to Mu'adh

supplications.title: Du'a for Khashyah — Fear and Awe of Allah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا يَحُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaqsim lanā min khashyatika mā yaḥūlu baynanā wa bayna ma'āṣīk.
supplications.translation: O Allah, assign to us such fear of You as will stand between us and acts of disobedience to You.
supplications.when_to_recite: Asking for the level of fear of Allah that protects one from sin

supplications.title: Du'a for Yaqeen — Certainty of Faith
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ يَقِينِكَ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مُصِيبَاتِ الدُّنْيَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaqsim lanā min yaqīnika mā tuhawwinu bihi 'alaynā muṣībātad-dunyā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, grant us such certainty of faith as will make the trials of this world easy for us.
supplications.when_to_recite: Asking for yaqeen (certainty) — which softens worldly difficulties

supplications.title: Du'a for a Soft and Living Heart
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْ قَلْبِي قَاسِيًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma lā taj'al qalbī qāsiyan.
supplications.translation: O Allah, do not make my heart hard.
supplications.when_to_recite: When the heart feels hard or distant from Allah — a frequent du'a of the pious
supplications.source: Based on prophetic teachings on the heart

supplications.title: Du'a for Firm Repentance
supplications.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Yā muqallibal-qulūbi thabbit qalbī 'alā dīnik.
supplications.translation: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.
supplications.when_to_recite: Frequently — the Prophet ﷺ used to say this often

supplications.title: Du'a for Khushu — Humility in Prayer
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min qalbin lā yakhsha'.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a heart that does not humble itself.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before prayer, asking for presence of heart and humility

supplications.title: Du'a to Remain Firm in the Religion
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma yā muqallibal-qulūbi thabbit qalbī 'alā ṭā'atik.
supplications.translation: O Allah, O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm in Your obedience.
supplications.when_to_recite: For steadfastness in deen — especially in times of fitnah

supplications.title: Du'a for Ikhlas — Sincerity in Deeds
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ عَمَلِي صَالِحًا وَاجْعَلْهُ لَكَ خَالِصًا وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لِأَحَدٍ فِيهِ نَصِيبًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaj'al 'amalī ṣāliḥan waj'alhu laka khāliṣan wa lā taj'al li-aḥadin fīhi naṣībā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, make my deeds righteous and make them purely for You, and do not give anyone a share in them.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before any act of worship — asking for pure sincerity

supplications.title: Morning — Three Protections
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ وَالشَّكِّ وَالشِّقَاقِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minash-shirki wash-shakki wash-shiqāq.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating partners with You, from doubt, and from discord.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning protection adhkar

supplications.title: Evening — The Prophet's ﷺ Bedtime Du'a
supplications.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Bismika rabbī waḍa'tu janbī wa bika arfa'uh, fa'in amsakta nafsī farḥamhā wa in arsaltahā faḥfaẓhā bimā taḥfaẓu bihi 'ibādakaṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
supplications.translation: In Your name my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You release it, protect it with what You protect Your righteous servants.
supplications.when_to_recite: When lying down to sleep every night

supplications.title: Morning — Complete Du'a Upon Waking
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
supplications.transliteration: Alḥamdulillāhilladhī aḥyānā ba'da mā amātanā wa ilayhin-nushūr.
supplications.translation: All praise is for Allah who brought us to life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
supplications.when_to_recite: First words upon waking from sleep

supplications.title: Morning — Waking on a New Day
supplications.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
supplications.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥal-mulku lillāhi walḥamdulillāhi lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah.
supplications.translation: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no deity but Allah alone, with no partner.
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon waking in the morning

supplications.title: Evening — Entering the Night
supplications.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
supplications.transliteration: Amsaynā wa amsal-mulku lillāhi walḥamdulillāhi lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah.
supplications.translation: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no deity but Allah alone, with no partner.
supplications.when_to_recite: In the evening at sunset

supplications.title: Sending 100 Salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli 'alā Muḥammad.
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad.
supplications.when_to_recite: 100 times on Fridays and regularly — for every salawat, Allah sends 10 blessings upon the person

supplications.title: Du'a After Fajr — Prophet's ﷺ Morning Request
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'an wa rizqan ṭayyiban wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
supplications.when_to_recite: After Fajr prayer before sunrise — a daily commitment

supplications.title: Du'a for Protection — After Maghrib and Fajr
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu yuḥyī wa yumītu wa huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
supplications.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things capable.
supplications.when_to_recite: 10 times after Maghrib and Fajr

supplications.title: Rabbana — We Believe in Allah (End of Al-Baqara)
supplications.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Āmanar-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihi wal-mu'minūn, kullun āmana billāhi wa malā'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih...
supplications.translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, as have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah, His angels, His books, and His messengers...
supplications.when_to_recite: Every night before sleep — these two ayat (2:285-286) suffice whoever recites them

supplications.title: Rabbana — Forgive Us and Admit Us to Paradise
supplications.arabic: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā innanā sami'nā munādiyan yunādī lil-īmāni an āminū birabbikum fa-āmannā. Rabbanā faghfir lanā dhunūbanā...
supplications.translation: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins...
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of the people of understanding (Ulu al-Albab) — reflecting on creation and asking for forgiveness

supplications.title: Rabbana — O My Lord, Adversity Has Touched Me
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi annī massaniyad-dhurru wa anta arḥamur-rāḥimīn.
supplications.translation: My Lord, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
supplications.when_to_recite: In prolonged illness or suffering — du'a of Ayyub alayhis salam; Allah responded and removed his affliction

supplications.title: Rabbana — I Am In Need of Your Goodness
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.
supplications.translation: My Lord, I am in desperate need of whatever good You might send down to me.
supplications.when_to_recite: In any state of need — du'a of Musa alayhis salam after helping the women; then Allah provided him with a home and spouse

supplications.title: Rabbana — Grant Me from the Righteous
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
supplications.translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of Ibrahim alayhis salam for a righteous son — Allah gave him Ismail alayhis salam

supplications.title: Rabbana — I Have Vowed My Child to You
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi innī nadhartu laka mā fī baṭnī muḥarraran fataqabbal minnī innaka antas-samī'ul-'alīm.
supplications.translation: My Lord, I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of the mother of Maryam — dedicating a child to Allah's service

supplications.title: Rabbana — Grant Us Mercy and Guidance
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā milladunka raḥmatan wa hayyi' lanā min amrinā rashadā.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking mercy and right direction — du'a of the companions of the cave

supplications.title: Rabbana — Enter Me in Truth, Exit Me in Truth
supplications.arabic: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnī mudkhala ṣidqin wa akhrijnī mukhraja ṣidqin waj'al lī milladunka sulṭānan naṣīrā.
supplications.translation: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.
supplications.when_to_recite: When beginning or ending any significant situation

supplications.title: Rabbana — Perfect Our Light and Forgive Us
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā waghfir lanā innaka 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of the believers crossing the bridge on Judgment Day — recite it asking for light and forgiveness now

supplications.title: Rabbana — Forgive Us and Those Who Preceded Us
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanāghfir lanā wa li-ikhwāninālladhīna sabaqūnā bil-īmān.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith.
supplications.when_to_recite: For all Muslims who came before — a du'a for the entire Ummah across generations

supplications.title: Rabbana — We Have Put Trust in You
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā 'alayka tawakkalnā wa ilayka anabnā wa ilaykal-maṣīr.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
supplications.when_to_recite: The du'a of Ibrahim alayhis salam and believers — complete reliance on Allah

supplications.title: Rabbana — Do Not Make Us a Test for Disbelievers
