supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā lā taj'alnā fitnatan lilladhīna kafarū waghfir lanā rabbanā innaka antal-'azīzul-ḥakīm.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, do not make us [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
supplications.when_to_recite: When Muslims are being persecuted or used as a trial

supplications.title: Rabbana — Accept Our Hajj and Make Us Muslims
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā waj'alnā muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatinā ummatan muslimatan laka wa arinā manāsikanā wa tub 'alaynā innaka antat-tawwābur-raḥīm.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
supplications.when_to_recite: The du'a of Ibrahim and Ismail alayhima as-salam while building the Kaaba — perfect for Hajj

supplications.title: Rabbana — I Have Settled My Family Near the Kaaba
supplications.arabic: رَّبَّنَا إِنِّي أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةً مِّنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā innī askantu min dhurriyyatī biwādin ghayri dhī zar'in 'inda baytika l-muḥarrami rabbanā liyuqīmuṣ-ṣalāta faj'al af'idatan minan-nāsi tahwī ilayhim.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.
supplications.when_to_recite: The original du'a that brought pilgrims to Makkah — Ibrahim's prayer for the city and its visitors

supplications.title: Rabbana — Forgive Me and My Parents on Judgment Day
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanāghfir lī wa liwālidayya wa lil-mu'minīna yawma yaqūmul-ḥisāb.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of Ibrahim alayhis salam — for oneself, parents, and all believers

supplications.title: Rabbana — Do Not Burden Us Beyond Our Capacity
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bihi wa'fu 'annā waghfir lanā warḥamnā anta mawlānā.
supplications.translation: Our Lord, do not burden us with what we cannot bear; pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector.
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling overwhelmed or overburdened

supplications.title: Hasbiyallah — Sufficient is Allah for Me
supplications.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'aẓīm.
supplications.translation: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
supplications.when_to_recite: 7 times morning and evening — Allah will suffice the person in his worldly and hereafter matters

supplications.title: Du'a on an Airplane or Ship
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Subḥānal-ladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn.
supplications.translation: Glory be to He who has subjected this to us — we could not have done this ourselves.
supplications.when_to_recite: When boarding any vehicle — plane, ship, train, car

supplications.title: Du'a Before and After Using the Restroom
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
supplications.transliteration: A'ūdhu billāhi minal-khubthi wal-khabā'ith.
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from male and female evil spirits.
supplications.when_to_recite: Said with Bismillah before entering; say Ghufranak upon exit

supplications.title: Du'a Before Wudu — Ablution
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāh.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: Before beginning wudu — wudu without Bismillah has no light

supplications.title: Full Du'a After Wudu
supplications.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan 'abduhu wa rasūluh. Allāhummaj'alnī minat-tawwābīna waj'alnī minal-mutaṭahhirīn.
supplications.translation: I bear witness that there is no deity but Allah alone with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves.
supplications.when_to_recite: Immediately after completing wudu — the 8 gates of Paradise open for whoever says this

supplications.title: Du'a When Seeing Fire or Hearing a Siren
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنَا مِنَ النَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ajirnā minan-nār.
supplications.translation: O Allah, protect us from the Fire.
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeing fire or flames — a reminder to seek protection from Hellfire

supplications.title: Du'a When Getting in a Car
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا
supplications.transliteration: Bismillāhi walḥamdulillāhi subḥānal-ladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā.
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. Glory be to He who subjected this to us.
supplications.when_to_recite: When getting into any vehicle before a journey

supplications.title: Du'a of Yusuf in Hardship
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbis-sijnu aḥabbu ilayya mimmā yad'ūnanī ilayhi wa illā taṣrif 'annī kaydahunna aṣbu ilayhinna wa akun minal-jāhilīn.
supplications.translation: My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of Yusuf alayhis salam — when facing temptation, choosing hardship over sin

supplications.title: Seeking Help Through Patience and Prayer
supplications.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanu ista'īnū biṣ-ṣabri waṣ-ṣalāti innallāha ma'aṣ-ṣābirīn.
supplications.translation: O you who believe, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
supplications.when_to_recite: A Quranic command and reminder in difficulty — recite and act on it

supplications.title: Du'a for Sustenance When in Desperate Need
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummakfinī biḥalālika 'an ḥarāmika wa aghnini bifaḍlika 'amman siwāk.
supplications.translation: O Allah, make Your lawful provision sufficient for me so that I am free from the unlawful, and enrich me through Your bounty so that I need no one besides You.
supplications.when_to_recite: In poverty, financial hardship, or when unemployed

supplications.title: Kaffara — Expiation for Sins of a Gathering
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
supplications.transliteration: SubḥānakAllāhumma wa biḥamdika lā ilāha illā anta astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk.
supplications.translation: Glory be to You O Allah and with Your praise. There is no deity but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
supplications.when_to_recite: At the end of any gathering — expiates what was said in it

supplications.title: Du'a Between Adhan and Iqamah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaghfir lī wa tub 'alayy.
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive me and accept my repentance.
supplications.when_to_recite: Between the adhan and iqamah — du'a is not rejected at this time

supplications.title: Conditions of Sincere Tawbah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ الَّذِي أَذْنَبْتُهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī atūbu ilayka minadh-dhanbilladhī adhnabtuhu.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I repent to You from the sin that I have committed.
supplications.when_to_recite: Specific repentance for a known sin — with genuine remorse and commitment not to return
supplications.source: Based on prophetic teachings on tawbah

supplications.title: Du'a for a Good Death — Ending on Faith
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ عُمْرِي آخِرَهُ وَخَيْرَ عَمَلِي خَوَاتِمَهُ وَخَيْرَ أَيَّامِي يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhummaj'al khayra 'umrī ākhirah, wa khayra 'amalī khawātimah, wa khayra ayyāmī yawma alqāk.
supplications.translation: O Allah, make the best part of my life its end, the best of my deeds their conclusion, and the best of my days the day I meet You.
supplications.when_to_recite: Regularly — asking for a good ending and death in a state of iman

supplications.title: Du'a for Protection from Senility and Memory Loss
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَرَمِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika minal-harami wal-kasali wal-jubni wal-bukhl.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from senility, laziness, cowardice, and miserliness.
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — protection from the weakness of old age

supplications.title: Du'a When Needing Help from Allah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي وَلَا تُعِنْ عَلَيَّ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma a'innī wa lā tu'in 'alayy.
supplications.translation: O Allah, help me and do not let others overpower me.
supplications.when_to_recite: When in need of divine assistance against any opponent or difficulty

supplications.title: Du'a for Barakah in Time
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي أَوْقَاتِنَا وَأَعِنَّا عَلَى حُسْنِ اسْتِغْلَالِهَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma bārik lanā fī awqātinā wa a'innā 'alā ḥusni istighllālihā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, bless our time and help us to use it well.
supplications.when_to_recite: At the start of the day or week — asking for time to be blessed and productive
supplications.source: Based on prophetic teachings on time management

supplications.title: Du'a for Those Calling to Islam
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِ قَوْمِي فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ihdi qawmī fa'innahum lā ya'lamūn.
supplications.translation: O Allah, guide my people, for they do not know.
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of the Prophet ﷺ when injured at Taif — for guidance of those who oppose or reject Islam

supplications.title: Du'a for the City of Madinah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ كَحُبِّنَا مَكَّةَ أَوْ أَشَدَّ وَصَحِّحْهَا
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma ḥabbib ilayna l-Madīnata kaḥubbinā Makkata aw ashadda wa ṣaḥḥiḥhā.
supplications.translation: O Allah, make us love Madinah as much as we love Makkah or even more, and make it healthy for us.
supplications.when_to_recite: When visiting or thinking of Madinah — the Prophet's ﷺ own du'a for his city

supplications.title: Du'a for the City of Makkah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَرَّمَ مَكَّةَ وَدَعَا لَهَا وَإِنِّي أُحَرِّمُ الْمَدِينَةَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma inna Ibrāhīma ḥarrama Makkata wa da'ā lahā wa innī uḥarrimul-Madīnah.
supplications.translation: O Allah, Ibrahim declared Makkah as a sanctuary and supplicated for it...
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a recognizing the sanctity of Makkah — recite when in Makkah

supplications.title: Du'a After Hearing the Adhan
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba hādhihid-da'watit-tāmmati waṣ-ṣalātil-qā'imati āti Muḥammadanil-wasīlata wal-faḍīlah.
supplications.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer to be offered, grant Muhammad the privilege and the distinction.
supplications.when_to_recite: After the adhan — intercession of the Prophet ﷺ is guaranteed for whoever says this

supplications.title: Repeating the Adhan Words
supplications.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illallāhu wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan rasūlullāh.
supplications.translation: I bear witness that there is no deity but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.
supplications.when_to_recite: Repeat each phrase of the adhan after the muadhdhin — then say the opening du'a

supplications.title: The Greatest Du'a — Day of Arafat
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
supplications.translation: There is no deity but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is able to do all things.
supplications.when_to_recite: The best du'a on the best day — Yawm al-Arafah. Repeat abundantly on that day

supplications.title: Du'a When Spouse Is Sick
supplications.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
supplications.transliteration: As'alullāhal-'aẓīma rabbal-'arshil-'aẓīmi an yashfiyak.
supplications.translation: I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to cure you.
supplications.when_to_recite: When your spouse is ill — said 7 times for full cure if recovery is decreed

supplications.title: Du'a for Fasting Monday and Thursday
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصُومُ هَذَا الْيَوْمَ لَكَ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ
supplications.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aṣūmu hādhal-yawma laka wa 'alayka tawakkaltu.
supplications.translation: O Allah, I fast this day for Your sake and upon You I rely.
supplications.when_to_recite: When fasting voluntary fasts (Monday, Thursday, White Days, etc.)
supplications.source: Based on prophetic teachings on voluntary fasting

supplications.title: Signs of Accepted Du'a — Increase and Continue
supplications.arabic: ادْعُوا رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Ud'ū rabbakum taḍarru'an wa khufyatan innahu lā yuḥibbul-mu'tadīn.
supplications.translation: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately. Indeed, He does not like transgressors.
supplications.when_to_recite: A reminder of the adab of du'a — call with humility and lowness

supplications.title: Complete Tasbih After Prayer
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣) وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣) وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٣) لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaan-Allaah (33×), Al-hamdu Lillaah (33×), Allaahu Akbar (33×). Laa ilaaha ill-Allaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah (×33), Praise be to Allah (×33), Allah is the Greatest (×33). None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things All-Powerful
supplications.when_to_recite: After each obligatory prayer

supplications.title: Ayat al-Kursi After Prayer
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, al-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhoo sinatuw-walaa nawm
supplications.translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep
supplications.when_to_recite: After each obligatory prayer — one who recites it will be in Allah's protection until the next prayer

supplications.title: Last Two Verses of Al-Baqarah
supplications.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ
supplications.transliteration: Aamanar-rasulu bimaa unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihi wal-mu'minoon
supplications.translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers
supplications.when_to_recite: Evening; suffices whoever recites them at night

supplications.title: Du'a for Steadfastness
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma a'innee 'alaa dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibaadatik
supplications.translation: O Allah, help me remember You, be grateful to You, and worship You in an excellent manner
supplications.when_to_recite: After every obligatory prayer, particularly Fajr and 'Asr

supplications.title: Entering the Mosque
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma iftah lee abwaaba rahmatik
supplications.translation: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me
supplications.when_to_recite: When entering the mosque, stepping in with the right foot first

supplications.title: Leaving the Mosque
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka min fadlik
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty
supplications.when_to_recite: When leaving the mosque, stepping out with the left foot first

supplications.title: Prayer for the First Row
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَارْحَمْنِا مَعَهُمْ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammad wa 'alaa aali Muhammad warhamna ma'ahum
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and have mercy upon us with them
supplications.when_to_recite: When making du'a in the mosque

supplications.title: While Waiting for Prayer
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aj'alnee minat-tawwabeena waj'alnee minal-mutatahhireen
supplications.translation: O Allah, make me among those who repent often and make me among those who purify themselves
supplications.when_to_recite: While waiting in the mosque for the prayer to begin

supplications.title: Before Wudu
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: Before beginning ablution (wudu)

supplications.title: After Completing Wudu
supplications.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Ash-hadu allaa ilaaha ill-Allaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasooluh. Allaahumma aj'alnee minat-tawwabeena waj'alnee minal-mutatahhireen
supplications.translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner; and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who repent often and make me among those who purify themselves
supplications.when_to_recite: Immediately after completing ablution

supplications.title: Shahada After Wudu
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika ash-hadu allaa ilaaha illaa anta astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk
supplications.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and with Your praise I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but You; I seek Your forgiveness and I repent to You
supplications.when_to_recite: After performing wudu

supplications.title: Between Adhan and Iqamah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّداً الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabba haadhihid-da'watit-taammah, was-salatil-qaa'imah, aati Muhammadan al-waseelata wal-fadeelah
supplications.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the intercession and the supreme rank
supplications.when_to_recite: After hearing the adhan — du'a between adhan and iqamah is accepted

supplications.title: Response to the Adhan
supplications.arabic: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
supplications.transliteration: Wa ana ash-hadu allaa ilaaha ill-Allaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasooluh
supplications.translation: And I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger
supplications.when_to_recite: After responding to each phrase of the adhan

supplications.title: Opening Du'a of Prayer (Dua al-Istiftah)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma baa'id baynee wa bayna khataayaaya kamaa baa'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib. Allaahumma naqqinee minal-khataayaa
supplications.translation: O Allah, separate me from my sins as You have separated the East from the West. O Allah, cleanse me of my sins
supplications.when_to_recite: Opening of the voluntary night prayer (also recited in fard by some)

supplications.title: The Best Dhikr
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allaah
supplications.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: At all times — the Prophet ﷺ said it is the best dhikr

supplications.title: Subhanallah wa Bihamdihi
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaan-Allaahi wa bihamdih
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah and with His praise
supplications.when_to_recite: At any time — whoever says it 100 times, his sins are forgiven even if they are like sea foam

supplications.title: Two Beloved Phrases
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaan-Allaahil-'Azeem. Subhaan-Allaahi wa bihamdih
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah the Magnificent. Glory be to Allah and with His praise
supplications.when_to_recite: At any time — light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful

supplications.title: Hasbunallah wa Ni'mal Wakeel
supplications.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
supplications.transliteration: Hasbunallaahu wa ni'mal-wakeel
supplications.translation: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best Disposer of affairs
supplications.when_to_recite: In times of hardship, fear, or when facing overwhelming circumstances

supplications.title: La Hawla wa La Quwwata
supplications.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah
supplications.translation: There is no power and no strength except with Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: Continuously — a treasure from the treasures of Paradise

supplications.title: Seeking Forgiveness 100 Times
supplications.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
supplications.transliteration: Astaghfirullaaha wa atoobu ilayh
supplications.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him
supplications.when_to_recite: Repeated 100 times daily — the Prophet ﷺ himself did this

supplications.title: Sending Blessings on the Prophet ﷺ
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammad
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad
supplications.when_to_recite: Frequently — one salawat brings ten blessings from Allah

supplications.title: The Best Morning Remembrance
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
supplications.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things
supplications.when_to_recite: 100 times in the morning — equals freeing 10 slaves, brings 100 good deeds, erases 100 sins

supplications.title: Prayer for Open Heart & Eloquence
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi ishrah lee sadree, wa yassir lee amree, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisaanee, yafqahoo qawlee
supplications.translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech
supplications.when_to_recite: Before speaking, teaching, giving a talk, or any difficult conversation

supplications.title: Du'a of Yunus (Jonah)
supplications.arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illaa anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz-zaalimeen
supplications.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers
supplications.when_to_recite: In any difficulty or distress — the du'a that freed Prophet Yunus from the whale's belly

supplications.title: Du'a of Adam and Hawwa
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa illam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakoona minal-khasireen
supplications.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers
supplications.when_to_recite: When repenting from sin; taught to Adam and Hawwa by Allah

supplications.title: Prayer Against Going Astray
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da idh hadaytanaa wa hab lanaa mil-ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhaab
supplications.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — fear of going astray after guidance

supplications.title: La Yukallifullahu Nafsan — Complete
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbana laa tu'aakhidhnaa in naseenaa aw akhtanaa. Rabbana wa laa tahmil 'alaynaa isran kamaa hamaltahu 'alal-ladheena min qablinaa. Rabbana wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih. Wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaaa, anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen
supplications.translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people
supplications.when_to_recite: End of Surah al-Baqarah — recited every night; Allah said 'I have done it'

supplications.title: Prayer for Righteous Family
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbana hab lanaa min azwaajina wa dhurriyyaatinaa qurrata a'yunin waj'alnaa lil-muttaqeena imaamaa
supplications.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous
supplications.when_to_recite: Supplication for righteous spouse, children, and leadership in piety

supplications.title: Du'a of Gratitude (Prophet Sulayman)
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas-saaliheen
supplications.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into the ranks of Your righteous servants
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning dhikr, when receiving blessings — taught by Allah through Prophet Sulayman

supplications.title: Du'a of the People of the Cave
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbana aatinaa milladunka rahmataw-wa hayyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
supplications.translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeking guidance in a difficult decision or situation

supplications.title: Du'a of Ibrahim for Offspring
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi aj'alnee muqeemas-salaati wa min dhurriyyatee. Rabbana wa taqabbal du'aa
supplications.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication
supplications.when_to_recite: Praying for oneself and one's children to be steadfast in prayer

supplications.title: Du'a of the Angels for the Believers
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbana wasi'ta kulla shay'ir-rahmataw-wa 'ilman faghfir lilladheena taaboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka wa qihim 'adhabal-jaheem
supplications.translation: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire
supplications.when_to_recite: A du'a made by the angels on behalf of believers — recite it for yourself and others

supplications.title: Prayer for Believers Past and Present
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lanaa wa li-ikhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaan wa laa taj'al fee quloobinaa ghillan lilladheena aamanoo Rabbanaa innaka Ra'oofur-Raheem
supplications.translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a for the entire ummah, past and present

supplications.title: Prayer of the People of Understanding
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanaa innanaa sami'naa munaadiyay-yunaadee lil-eemaan an aaminoo bi-rabbikum fa-aamannaa. Rabbana faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa kaffir 'annaa sayyi'aatinaa wa tawaffanaa ma'al abraar
supplications.translation: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, saying, 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous
supplications.when_to_recite: Evening — for forgiveness and a righteous end

supplications.title: Opening Du'a for Tahajjud
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ لَكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamd, anta qayyimus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn. Wa lakal-hamd, laka mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn
supplications.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise. You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is in them. To You belongs all praise; Yours is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is in them
supplications.when_to_recite: The Prophet ﷺ used to begin the night prayer with this du'a

supplications.title: Du'a al-Istikhara
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee astakheeruka bi'ilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratika wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'azeem, fa'innaka taqdiru wa laa aqdiru, wa ta'lamu wa laa a'lamu, wa anta 'Allaamul-ghuyoob
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge, and I seek ability by Your power, and I ask You from Your great bounty. For You have power and I have none, You know and I know not, and You are the Knower of hidden things
supplications.when_to_recite: After 2 raka'ah of voluntary prayer, when making an important decision

supplications.title: Du'a al-Qunoot (Witr Prayer)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahummahdini feeman hadayt, wa 'aafinee feeman 'aafayt, wa tawallanee feeman tawallayt, wa baarik lee feemaa a'tayt, wa qinee sharra maa qadayt
supplications.translation: O Allah, guide me among those whom You have guided, pardon me among those whom You have pardoned, befriend me among those whom You have befriended, bless me in what You have granted, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed
supplications.when_to_recite: In the Witr prayer — the Prophet ﷺ taught this to al-Hasan ibn Ali

supplications.title: Allah Descends in the Last Third
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma anta rabbee, laa ilaaha illaa anta, khalaqtanee wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can
supplications.when_to_recite: In the last third of the night — Allah descends and asks who will call upon Him

supplications.title: Seeing the New Crescent Moon
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-eemaan, was-salaamati wal-islaam. Rabbee wa rabbuk-Allaah
supplications.translation: O Allah, bring it over us with security, faith, safety, and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon sighting the new crescent moon (for Ramadan or any month)

supplications.title: Du'a for Breaking Fast (Iftar)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma laka sumtu wa 'alaa rizqika aftart
supplications.translation: O Allah, for You I have fasted and with Your provision I have broken my fast
supplications.when_to_recite: At the moment of breaking the fast at sunset

supplications.title: After Breaking Fast
supplications.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Dhahaba az-zama'u wabtallatil-'urooqu wa thabatal-ajru inshaAllah
supplications.translation: The thirst has gone, the veins are quenched, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills
supplications.when_to_recite: After breaking the fast and drinking water

supplications.title: Du'a for Laylat al-Qadr
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'annee
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are the Pardoning One, You love to pardon, so pardon me
supplications.when_to_recite: On the night of Laylat al-Qadr (seek it in the odd nights of the last 10 of Ramadan) — taught by the Prophet ﷺ to Aisha (ra)

supplications.title: Blessing of Suhoor (Pre-Dawn Meal)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Allahumma baarik lanaa feema razaqtanaa wa qinaa 'adhaaban-naar, bismillaah
supplications.translation: O Allah, bless for us what You have provided us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire. In the name of Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: At the suhoor meal before Fajr

supplications.title: Full Du'a Before Entering Ihram
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ الْعُمْرَةَ وَالْحَجَّ فَيَسِّرْهُمَا لِي وَتَقَبَّلْهُمَا مِنِّي
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee ureedul-'umrata wal-hajj, fayassir-humaa lee wa taqabbal-humaa minnee
supplications.translation: O Allah, I intend to perform Umrah and Hajj, so make them easy for me and accept them from me
supplications.when_to_recite: Before wearing the Ihram garments and making the intention

supplications.title: Starting Each Circuit of Tawaf
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِيمَانًا بِكَ وَتَصْدِيقًا بِكِتَابِكَ وَوَفَاءً بِعَهْدِكَ وَاتِّبَاعًا لِسُنَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah, Allaahu Akbar. Allaahumma eemaanan bika wa tasdeeqan bikitaabika wa wafaa'an bi-'ahdika wattibaa'an li-sunnati nabiyyika Muhammad sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, out of faith in You, belief in Your Book, fulfillment of Your covenant, and following the Sunnah of Your Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
supplications.when_to_recite: At the beginning of each circuit of Tawaf, upon reaching the Black Stone

supplications.title: While Walking Between Safa and Marwa
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَاعْفُ وَتَكَرَّمْ وَتَجَاوَزْ عَمَّا تَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا لَا نَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْأَعَزُّ الْأَكْرَمُ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbighfir warham wa'fu wa takarram wa tajaawaz 'ammaa ta'lam, innaka ta'lamu maa laa na'lam, innaka antal-a'azzul-akram
supplications.translation: My Lord, forgive, have mercy, pardon, be generous, and overlook that which You know. Indeed You know what we do not know. Indeed You are the Mightiest and Most Generous
supplications.when_to_recite: While walking the path between Safa and Marwah during Sa'i

supplications.title: At Muzdalifah (After Leaving Arafat)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُعِينَنِي عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَطَاعَةِ رَسُولِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka an tu'eenani 'alaa taa'atika wa taa'ati rasoolika
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You to help me in obeying You and obeying Your Messenger
supplications.when_to_recite: At Muzdalifah after leaving Arafat, spending the night there

supplications.title: First Stoning of the Small Jamarat
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ حَجًّا مَبْرُورًا وَسَعْيًا مَشْكُورًا
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aj'alhu hajjan mabrooraw-wa sa'yan mashkooraa
supplications.translation: O Allah, make it an accepted Hajj and an appreciated effort
supplications.when_to_recite: After pelting the small Jamarat (Jamarah al-Sughra) on the Days of Tashreeq

supplications.title: Praising Allah for All Conditions
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
supplications.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillaahi 'alaa kulli haal
supplications.translation: All praise is due to Allah in every condition
supplications.when_to_recite: At all times, in ease and hardship alike — gratitude in adversity is a mark of the believer

supplications.title: Gratitude After Eating
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
supplications.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee at'amanee haadha wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa laa quwwah
supplications.translation: All praise is due to Allah Who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or strength on my part
supplications.when_to_recite: After finishing a meal — whoever says this, his past sins are forgiven

supplications.title: Du'a When Looking in the Mirror
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma anta hassanta khalqee fa-hassin khuluqee
supplications.translation: O Allah, You have made my physical form beautiful, so make my character beautiful too
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon looking in a mirror

supplications.title: When Receiving a Blessing
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
supplications.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee bi-ni'matihi tatimmuss-saalihaat
supplications.translation: All praise is due to Allah, by Whose grace all good things are completed
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon receiving any blessing, good news, or completing a good act

supplications.title: Prayer for Contentment
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قَنِّعْنِي بِمَا رَزَقْتَنِي وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ وَاخْلُفْ عَلَيَّ كُلَّ غَائِبَةٍ لِي بِخَيْرٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma qanni'nee bimaa razaqtanee wa baarik lee feehi wakhluf 'alayya kulla ghaa'ibatin lee bikhayrin
supplications.translation: O Allah, make me content with what You have provided me, bless it for me, and replace every absence in my life with something better
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning, or when feeling a sense of longing or dissatisfaction

supplications.title: Remembering Death
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil-qabri wa min 'adhaabinNaari wa min fitnatil-mahyaa wal-mamaat
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the torment of the grave, from the punishment of the Fire, and from the trials of life and death
supplications.when_to_recite: End of every prayer — the Prophet ﷺ used to seek refuge from these four regularly

supplications.title: Prayer for a Good End (Husn al-Khatima)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالإِيمَانِ وَاخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالأَعْمَالِ الصَّالِحَةِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma akhtim lanaa bil-eemaan, wa akhtim lanaa bil-a'malis-saalihah
supplications.translation: O Allah, seal our lives with faith, and seal our lives with righteous deeds
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — praying for a good end to one's life

supplications.title: Refuge from Punishment of the Grave
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-jannah wa a'oodhu bika minan-naar
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge with You from the Fire
supplications.when_to_recite: Often — simplest and most comprehensive du'a for the Hereafter

supplications.title: For Those in the Barzakh (Intermediate Realm)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ وَعَافِهِمْ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُمْ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahummaghfir lahum warhamhum wa 'aafihim wa'fu 'anhum wa akrim nuzulahum
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive them, have mercy on them, grant them well-being, pardon them, and honor their resting place
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a for deceased believers in their graves

supplications.title: Special Du'a for Deceased Parents
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا وَأَدْخِلْهُمَا الْجَنَّةَ مَعَ الأَبْرَارِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahummaghfir li-waalidayya warhamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheera, wa adkhilhumaal-jannata ma'al-abraar
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive my parents and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small, and admit them to Paradise with the righteous
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — one of the most beloved acts after a parent passes away

supplications.title: Greeting Another Muslim
supplications.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
supplications.transliteration: As-Salaamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuh
supplications.translation: Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah, and His blessings
supplications.when_to_recite: When meeting any Muslim — the complete form carries maximum reward

supplications.title: Replying to the Salam
supplications.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
supplications.transliteration: Wa 'alaykumus-salaamu wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuh
supplications.translation: And upon you be peace, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings
supplications.when_to_recite: Always reply to a salam with an equal or better response

supplications.title: Responding to a Sneeze
supplications.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Yarhamuk-Allaah
supplications.translation: May Allah have mercy on you
supplications.when_to_recite: When someone sneezes and says 'Alhamdulillah', respond with this

supplications.title: After Sneezing
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillaah
supplications.translation: All praise is due to Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: Immediately after sneezing

supplications.title: Bidding Farewell
supplications.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
supplications.transliteration: Astawdi'ukumul-laahallazee laa tadeeu wadaa'i'uh
supplications.translation: I entrust you to Allah, Whose trusts are never lost
supplications.when_to_recite: When saying goodbye to family or friends for a journey

supplications.title: Congratulating Someone
supplications.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
supplications.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka wa jama'a baynakumaa fee khayr
supplications.translation: May Allah bless you and shower blessings upon you and join you both in goodness
supplications.when_to_recite: Congratulating a newlywed couple — this is the Sunnah congratulation for marriage

supplications.title: Congratulating on New Clothes
supplications.arabic: تُبْلِي وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Tublee wa yukhliful-laah
supplications.translation: May you wear it out and may Allah replace it
supplications.when_to_recite: When someone is wearing new clothing and you want to congratulate them

supplications.title: Du'a for One Who Feeds You
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma baarik lahum feemaa razaqtahum waghfir lahum warhamhum
supplications.translation: O Allah, bless for them what You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy on them
supplications.when_to_recite: When you have been fed by someone — du'a in their favour

supplications.title: Seeking Refuge from Anger
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-shaytaanir-rajeem
supplications.translation: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed Satan
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling anger — the Prophet ﷺ said this extinguishes anger

supplications.title: Du'a for a Newborn Baby
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُعِيذُهُ بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee u'eedhuhoo bika wa dhurriyyatahoo minash-shaytaanir-rajeem
supplications.translation: O Allah, I entrust him/her and his/her descendants to Your protection from the accursed Satan
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon the birth of a child — as Ibrahim and Maryam's mother made this du'a

supplications.title: When Your Child Leaves or Returns Home
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah, tawakkalnaa 'alal-laah, laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, we place our trust in Allah, there is no power or strength except with Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: When a family member departs or when your child leaves the house

supplications.title: Gratitude for One's Spouse
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلَحْتَ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا فَاجْعَلْ حُبَّنَا دَائِمًا
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma allafta bayna quloobinaa wa aslahta dhata bayninaa faj'al hubbanaa daa'imaa
supplications.translation: O Allah, You have united our hearts and reconciled between us, so make our love for each other everlasting
supplications.when_to_recite: Gratitude du'a for a spouse — to be said in morning or evening adhkar

supplications.title: Thanksgiving for a Righteous Child
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayy
supplications.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents
supplications.when_to_recite: When seeing your child engaged in worship or good conduct

supplications.title: Protection Du'a for Children at Night
supplications.arabic: أُعِيذُكَ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
supplications.transliteration: U'eedhuka bi-kalimaatil-laahit-taammati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli 'aynin laammah
supplications.translation: I seek protection for you in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature and from every evil eye
supplications.when_to_recite: Reciting over children at night — the Prophet ﷺ used to recite this over Hasan and Husain

supplications.title: Complete Ruqyah Du'a
supplications.arabic: أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
supplications.transliteration: Adhibil-ba'sa Rabban-naas, ishfi wa anta ash-shaafi, laa shifaa'a illaa shifaa'uk, shifaa'an laa yughaadiru saqamaa
supplications.translation: Remove the hardship, O Lord of mankind, grant healing for You are the Healer. There is no cure except Your cure, a cure that leaves no illness behind
supplications.when_to_recite: When sick or visiting the sick — the Prophet ﷺ used to recite this when visiting the ill

supplications.title: Blowing Surahs for Healing
supplications.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ (قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ) (قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ)
supplications.transliteration: Qul huwa Allaahu ahad (×3), Qul a'oodhu birabbil-falaq (×3), Qul a'oodhu birabbin-naas (×3)
supplications.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of Daybreak. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of Mankind — each recited 3 times
supplications.when_to_recite: Mornings and evenings and before sleeping — blow into palms and wipe over the body

supplications.title: Du'a Placing Hand on Pain
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
supplications.transliteration: A'oodhu bi'izzatil-laahi wa qudratihee min sharri maa ajidu wa uhaadzir
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in the might of Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I am wary of
supplications.when_to_recite: Place hand on the area of pain and say this 7 times

supplications.title: Protection from Epidemic and Plague
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-barasi wal-junooni wal-judhaaami wa min sayyi'il-asqaam
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from leprosy, madness, and elephantiasis, and from evil diseases
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning adhkar — seeking protection from severe illness

supplications.title: Prophetic Prescription for Morning
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah — said before eating seven 'Ajwah dates from Madinah in the morning
supplications.when_to_recite: Eating seven 'Ajwah dates in the morning — no magic or poison will harm you that day

supplications.title: Du'a for Lawful Livelihood
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma akfinee bihalaalika 'an haraamika wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwaak
supplications.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful so that I have no need of what You have made unlawful, and make me independent by Your grace of all besides You
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning adhkar, when facing financial difficulty

supplications.title: Du'a Entering the Marketplace
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyee wa yumeetu wa huwa hayyun laa yamootu biyadihil-khayr, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
supplications.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all goodness and He is over all things omnipotent
supplications.when_to_recite: When entering the marketplace or beginning a trade/work day

supplications.title: Du'a for Relief from Debt
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dhala'id-dayn, wa ghalabatir-rijaal
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — comprehensive protection from debilitating states

supplications.title: Du'a for Blessing in Trade
supplications.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي صَفْقَتِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka fee safqatik
supplications.translation: May Allah bless you in your transaction
supplications.when_to_recite: Said to someone when they complete a purchase or business deal

supplications.title: Before Studying or Learning
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa
supplications.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge
supplications.when_to_recite: Before any study session, lecture, or reading

supplications.title: Prayer for Understanding
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَقِّهْنِي فِي الدِّينِ وَعَلِّمْنِي التَّأْوِيلَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma faqqihnee fid-deen wa 'allimnit-ta'weel
supplications.translation: O Allah, grant me deep understanding of the religion and teach me its interpretation
supplications.when_to_recite: The du'a the Prophet ﷺ made for Ibn Abbas — seeking understanding of the Quran and religion

supplications.title: Prayer for Beneficial Knowledge
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka 'ilman naafi'an wa rizqan tayyiban wa 'amalan mutaqabbalaa
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is beneficial, provision that is good and pure, and deeds that are accepted
supplications.when_to_recite: After Fajr prayer — the Prophet ﷺ used to say this after the Fajr salam

supplications.title: Du'a Before an Exam or Test
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma laa sahla illaa maa ja'altahoo sahlan, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idhaa shi'ta sahlan
supplications.translation: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy when You will
supplications.when_to_recite: Before exams, interviews, or any challenging endeavor

supplications.title: Du'a for Good Memory
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaanaka laa 'ilma lanaa illaa maa 'allamtanaa innaka antal-'Aleemul-Hakeem
supplications.translation: Glory be to You! We have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise
supplications.when_to_recite: Before a study session, or when forgetting learned material

supplications.title: Du'a for Sincerity (Ikhlas)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ سَرِيرَتِي خَيْرًا مِنْ عَلَانِيَتِي وَاجْعَلْ عَلَانِيَتِي صَالِحَةً
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aj'al sareeratee khayran min 'alaaniyatee waj'al 'alaaniyatee saalihah
supplications.translation: O Allah, make my inner state better than my outward state, and make my outward state righteous
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — praying for sincerity between public and private self

supplications.title: Prayer for Humility
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكِبْرِ وَالْعُجْبِ وَالرِّيَاءِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-kibri wal-'ujbi war-riyaa'
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from arrogance, self-conceit, and showing off
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — protection from hidden spiritual diseases

supplications.title: Du'a for the Love of Allah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ وَحُبَّ كُلِّ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَى حُبِّكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka hubbaka wa hubba man yuhibbuk wa hubba kulli 'amalin yuqarribunee ilaa hubbik
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and the love of every deed that will draw me closer to Your love
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — seeking the highest spiritual goal

supplications.title: Du'a for Contentment with Decree
supplications.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
supplications.transliteration: Radeetu billaahi Rabbaa, wa bil-Islaami deenaa, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabiyyaa
supplications.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — 3 times; brings contentment and joy

supplications.title: Drawing Close to Allah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma allif bayna quloobinaa wa aslih dhaata bayninaa wahdina subulas-salaam
supplications.translation: O Allah, unite our hearts, reconcile between us, and guide us on paths of peace
supplications.when_to_recite: For community, family unity, and drawing collectively closer to Allah

supplications.title: Complete Reliance on Allah (Tawakkul)
supplications.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: Hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azeem
supplications.translation: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne
supplications.when_to_recite: When facing a situation beyond one's control — expressing full trust in Allah

supplications.title: Between Fear and Hope
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْخَوْفَ مِنْكَ فِي السِّرِّ وَالْعَلَانِيَةِ وَكَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka al-khawfa minka fis-sirri wal-'alaaniyyah wa kalimaatal-haqqi fir-ridaa wal-ghadab
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for fear of You in secret and in public, and for the word of truth in times of contentment and anger
supplications.when_to_recite: Seeking the balance of fear and hope that marks the sincere believer

supplications.title: Protecting Someone from Evil Eye
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِيهِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma baarik 'alayhi / Allaahumma baarik feeh
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon him / O Allah, bless him (or her, or it)
supplications.when_to_recite: When admiring something — say this instead of giving an evil eye

supplications.title: Children's Protection from Shaytan
supplications.arabic: أُعِيذُكَ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ
supplications.transliteration: U'eedhuka bi-kalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah
supplications.translation: I seek protection for you in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every biting creature
supplications.when_to_recite: Said over children to protect them from jinn and evil — Sunnah of the Prophet ﷺ

supplications.title: Protection from the Dajjal
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min fitnatil-Maseehid-Dajjaal
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the tribulation of the False Messiah (Dajjal)
supplications.when_to_recite: End of every prayer — the Prophet ﷺ commanded us to seek refuge from this

supplications.title: Protection from Hypocrisy
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النِّفَاقِ وَالشِّقَاقِ وَسُوءِ الْأَخْلَاقِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minan-nifaaqi wash-shiqaaqi wa soo'il-akhlaaq
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from hypocrisy, discord, and evil character
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — safeguarding one's character and integrity

supplications.title: Against Waswas (Whispers) in Prayer
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahis-Samee'il-'Aleemi minash-shaytaanir-rajeem
supplications.translation: I seek refuge with Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Satan
supplications.when_to_recite: When experiencing waswas (whispers/doubts) during prayer

supplications.title: Du'a for Muslim Leaders
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ أَئِمَّتَنَا وَوُلَاةَ أُمُورِنَا وَاجْعَلْ وِلَايَتَنَا فِيمَنْ خَافَكَ وَاتَّقَاكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aslih a'immatanaa wa wulaata umoorinaa waj'al wilaayatanaa feeman khafaka wattaqaak
supplications.translation: O Allah, reform our leaders and those in charge of our affairs, and make our leadership among those who fear You and are conscious of You
supplications.when_to_recite: For Muslim leaders and governance — this du'a has great communal benefit

supplications.title: Du'a for the Oppressed Ummah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْصُرِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma onsur al-muslimeenal-mustad'afeena fee kulli makaan
supplications.translation: O Allah, give victory to the weak and oppressed Muslims in every place
supplications.when_to_recite: For Muslims facing oppression and hardship around the world

supplications.title: For Deceased Scholars of Islam
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمِ الْعُلَمَاءَ الَّذِينَ عَلَّمُونَا دِينَنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّينَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma arhamil-'ulamaa'al-ladheena 'allamoonaa deenanaa wa adkhilhumul-jannata ma'an-nabiyyeen
supplications.translation: O Allah, have mercy on the scholars who taught us our religion, and admit them to Paradise with the Prophets
supplications.when_to_recite: For the scholars of Islam, past and present — their benefit to the ummah is immense

supplications.title: For Those Who Newly Accept Islam
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْ قُلُوبَهُمْ عَلَى دِينِكَ وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَعْوَانًا وَأَنْصَارًا
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma thabbit quloobahum 'alaa deenika waj'alnaa lahum a'waanaa wa ansaaraa
supplications.translation: O Allah, keep their hearts firm upon Your religion and make us supporters and helpers for them
supplications.when_to_recite: For new Muslims — asking Allah to keep them steadfast and for us to be good companions

supplications.title: Du'a in Extreme Heat
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مَا أَشَدَّ حَرَّ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنْ حَرِّ جَهَنَّمَ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allaah maa ashadda harra haadhil-yawm. Allaahumma ajirni min harri jahannam
supplications.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah — how intense is the heat of this day. O Allah, protect me from the heat of Hellfire
supplications.when_to_recite: On extremely hot days — using worldly heat as a reminder of the Hereafter

supplications.title: When a Light Goes Out
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُطْفِئْ نُورَنَا وَارْزُقْنَا النُّورَ التَّامَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma laa tutfi' nooranaa warzuqnan-noorat-taamma yawmal-qiyaamah
supplications.translation: O Allah, do not extinguish our light, and grant us the complete light on the Day of Resurrection
supplications.when_to_recite: When a light goes out — turning the mundane into spiritual remembrance

supplications.title: Upon First Seeing the Kaaba
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ فَحَيِّنَا رَبَّنَا بِالسَّلَامِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma antas-salaam wa minkas-salaam, fa-hayyinaa rabbanaa bis-salaam
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. O our Lord, grant us life with peace
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon first seeing the Kaaba — raise hands and make du'a

supplications.title: Du'a on Friday (Jumu'ah)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ الْكَرِيمِ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka bi-haqqi haadhil-yawmil-kareem an taghfira lee wa tarhamanee
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You by the sanctity of this noble day, to forgive me and have mercy on me
supplications.when_to_recite: Friday — the best day of the week; du'a is answered especially in the last hour

supplications.title: Entering the Home (Expanded)
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah walajnaa wa bismillaah kharajnaa wa 'alallaahi Rabbinaa tawakkalnaa
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we place our trust
supplications.when_to_recite: When entering the home — then greet those inside with salam

supplications.title: Before Giving a Speech or Lecture
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi ishrah lee sadree wa yassir lee amree wahlul 'uqdatan min lisaanee
supplications.translation: My Lord, expand my chest, ease my task, and remove the knot from my tongue
supplications.when_to_recite: Before public speaking, teaching, or any significant conversation

supplications.title: Du'a When Wind Blows
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka khayraha wa khayra maa feehaa wa khayra maa ursilat bih. Wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for its good and the good within it and the good it has been sent with, and I seek refuge with You from its evil
supplications.when_to_recite: When wind blows — never curse the wind

supplications.title: Du'a When Hearing Thunder
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaanal-ladhee yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihee wal-malaa'ikatu min kheefatih
supplications.translation: Glory be to the One Whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels in awe of Him
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon hearing thunder

supplications.title: When Waking at Night
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer. Subhaan-Allaah, wal-hamdu lillaah, wa laa ilaaha ill-Allaah, wallaahu Akbar
supplications.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, alone without partner. To Him belongs dominion and all praise, and He is Able to do all things. Glory be to Allah, all praise be to Allah, none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, Allah is the Greatest
supplications.when_to_recite: If one wakes during the night — then make du'a, it will be answered

supplications.title: Du'a When Dealing with a Difficult Person
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِ بِمَا شِئْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma akfineehi bimaa shi't
supplications.translation: O Allah, protect me from him/her however You will
supplications.when_to_recite: When confronted by someone who intends harm — a du'a of delegation to Allah

supplications.title: Prayer for All-Round Goodness
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka minal-khayri kullihee 'aajilihee wa aajilihee, maa 'alimtu minhu wa maa lam a'lam
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for all good, immediate and delayed, that which I know and that which I do not know
supplications.when_to_recite: Comprehensive du'a for all forms of goodness in this world and the next

supplications.title: Ten Salawat in the Morning
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammad wa 'alaa aali Muhammad 'ashran (×10)
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad — said ten times in the morning and evening
supplications.when_to_recite: 10 times each morning and evening — brings intercession of the Prophet ﷺ

supplications.title: Three Quls — Morning and Evening
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ (قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ) (قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ) (قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ)
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaahir-rahmaanir-raheem — Qul huwal-laahu ahad (3×), Qul a'oodhu bi-rabbil-falaq (3×), Qul a'oodhu bi-rabbin-naas (3×)
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: He is Allah, the One… Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak… Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind — each recited three times
supplications.when_to_recite: Every morning and evening — sufficient as protection for the day or night

supplications.title: Morning Supplication for Provision
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'aafiyata fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and in the Hereafter
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning — the Prophet ﷺ said well-being ('afiyah) is the best thing one can ask for after certainty of faith

supplications.title: Evening Protection from Harm
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee amsaytu ushhiduka wa ushhidu hamalata 'arshika wa malaa'ikataka wa jamee'a khalqika annaka anta Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa anta wahdaka laa shareeka lak, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasooluk
supplications.translation: O Allah, I reach the evening calling You to witness and calling to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all Your creation, that You are Allah; there is no deity except You alone, You have no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger
supplications.when_to_recite: 4 times in the evening — whoever says it, Allah frees a quarter of them from the Fire (×4 = full salvation)

supplications.title: Master Supplication of Forgiveness (Full)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma anta rabbee laa ilaaha illaa ant, khalaqtanee wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't. A'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana't. Aboo'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayya wa aboo'u bi-dhanbee, faghfir lee fa'innahoo laa yaghfiru adh-dhunooba illaa ant
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped but You. You created me and I am your servant, and I abide by your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my actions. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — Sayyid al-Istighfar; dying while saying this in the morning/evening guarantees Paradise

supplications.title: Comprehensive Evening Supplication
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma bika amsaynaa wa bika asbahna wa bika nahyaa wa bika namootu wa ilayka al-maseer
supplications.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the return
supplications.when_to_recite: Evening — mirror of the morning supplication

supplications.title: Two Raka'ah on Entering the Mosque
supplications.arabic: لَا تَجْلِسْ حَتَّى تَرْكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ
supplications.transliteration: Intention: to pray two rak'ah as tahiyyat al-masjid before sitting
supplications.translation: Do not sit until you pray two rak'ah (greeting the mosque)
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon entering the mosque — pray two voluntary rak'ah before sitting

supplications.title: The Duha Prayer
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ الضُّحَى ضُحَاؤُكَ وَالْبَهَاءَ بَهَاؤُكَ وَالْجَمَالَ جَمَالُكَ وَالْقُوَّةَ قُوَّتُكَ وَالْقُدْرَةَ قُدْرَتُكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innad-duhaa duhaa'uk, wal-bahaa'a bahaa'uk, wal-jamaala jamaaluk, wal-quwwata quwwatuk, wal-qudrata qudratuk
supplications.translation: O Allah, this forenoon is Your forenoon, this beauty is Your beauty, this splendor is Your splendor, this power is Your power, this might is Your might
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of the Duha (forenoon) prayer — prayed after sunrise until before midday

supplications.title: Intention to Pray Fajr Sunnah
supplications.arabic: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ سُنَّةً لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى
supplications.transliteration: Nawaytu an usalliya rak'atayl-fajri sunnatan lillaahi ta'aalaa
supplications.translation: I intend to pray the two Sunnah rak'ah of Fajr for the sake of Allah the Exalted
supplications.when_to_recite: Before the two sunnah rak'ah of Fajr — the Prophet ﷺ never missed these even while travelling

supplications.title: Before a Job Interview or Meeting
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلْقِ فِي قَلْبِهِ الرِّضَا عَنِّي وَاجْعَلْ لِي لَدَيْهِ قَبُولًا
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma alqi fee qalbihir-ridaa 'annee waj'al lee ladayhi qaboolaa
supplications.translation: O Allah, place contentment with me in their heart and grant me favor with them
supplications.when_to_recite: Before meeting someone you need to impress or whose acceptance you need

supplications.title: Du'a for Repaying Debt
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْضِ عَنِّي الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنِي مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma iqdi 'annid-dayna wa aghnini minal-faqr
supplications.translation: O Allah, pay off my debt on my behalf and enrich me from poverty
