supplications.when_to_recite: When carrying debt — alongside practical steps to repay it

supplications.title: Du'a for Stomach Pain
supplications.arabic: أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ بِيَدِكَ الشِّفَاءُ لَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
supplications.transliteration: Adhibil-ba'sa Rabban-naas, biyadikash-shifaa', laa kaashifa lahoo illaa ant
supplications.translation: Remove the ailment, O Lord of mankind. In Your hand is the cure; none can remove it but You
supplications.when_to_recite: For stomach pain, digestive ailments, or any internal physical discomfort

supplications.title: When Something Is Lost
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَادَّ الضَّالَّةِ وَهَادِيَ الضَّالِّ اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ بِإِذْنِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma raaddad-daallati wa haadiyad-daall, ihdinee limakhtulifa feehi bi-idniik
supplications.translation: O Allah, Returner of what is lost and Guide of those who are astray, guide me in what is disagreed upon, by Your permission
supplications.when_to_recite: When you have lost something and are looking for it

supplications.title: Patience During Prolonged Hardship
supplications.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
supplications.transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raaji'oon. Allaahumma ajurnee fee museebatee wa akhlif lee khayran minhaa
supplications.translation: Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me for my calamity and replace it with something better
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon any calamity — this du'a was confirmed by the Prophet ﷺ to bring Allah's reward and a better replacement

supplications.title: After a Nightmare
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
supplications.transliteration: A'oodhu bi-kalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min ghadabihee wa 'iqaabihee wa sharri 'ibaadihee wa min hamazaatish-shayaateeni wa an yahdureen
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His servants, and from the whisperings of the devils and from their coming to me
supplications.when_to_recite: After a bad dream — then spit lightly to the left, change sides, do not tell anyone

supplications.title: Du'a Against Poverty and Anxiety
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ وَالْقِلَّةِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wa a'oodhu bika minal-faqri wal-qillah
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, and I seek refuge with You from poverty and scarcity
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — especially during times of financial difficulty

supplications.title: When Praised by Others
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُنُّونَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma laa tu'aakhidhnee bimaa yaqooloona waghfir lee maa laa ya'lamoona waj'alnee khayran mimmaa yazunnoon
supplications.translation: O Allah, do not take me to account for what they say, forgive me for what they do not know, and make me better than what they think of me
supplications.when_to_recite: When someone praises you — to guard against pride

supplications.title: Thanking Someone for a Gift
supplications.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
supplications.transliteration: Jazaakallaahu khayran
supplications.translation: May Allah reward you with goodness
supplications.when_to_recite: When someone does something for you or gives you a gift — the highest form of thanks

supplications.title: Before a Difficult Conversation
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi ishrah lee sadree wa yassir lee amree
supplications.translation: My Lord, expand my chest and ease my task
supplications.when_to_recite: Before any difficult conversation, confrontation, or negotiation

supplications.title: Leaving Home for Hajj
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah, tawakkaltu 'alallaah, laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no power or strength except with Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: When leaving one's home to travel for Hajj

supplications.title: Boarding Transportation to Hajj
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaanal-ladhee sakhkhara lanaa haadha wa maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen, wa innaa ilaa rabbinaa lamunqaliboon
supplications.translation: Glory be to the One Who has subjected this to us, and we could not have done it ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we shall return
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon boarding any vehicle, plane, ship, or animal — the complete traveler's du'a

supplications.title: After the Talbiyah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رِضَاكَ وَالْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَالنَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka ridaaka wal-jannah, wa a'oodhu bika min sakhatika wan-naar
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your pleasure and for Paradise, and I seek refuge with You from Your displeasure and from the Fire
supplications.when_to_recite: After reciting the Talbiyah

supplications.title: When Touching or Pointing to the Black Stone
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِيمَاناً بِكَ وَتَصْدِيقاً بِكِتَابِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah, wallaahu akbar. Allaahumma eemaanan bika wa tasdeeqan bikitaabik
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, out of faith in You and belief in Your Book
supplications.when_to_recite: Each time you pass the Black Stone or point to it during Tawaf

supplications.title: Du'a in the Hateem (Hijr Ismail)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ قُلْتَ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ وَإِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ وَأَنَا أَسْأَلُكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innaka qulta: 'Ud'oonee astajib lakum,' wa innaka laa tukhlifu al-mee'aad. Wa ana as'aluk...
supplications.translation: O Allah, You have said: 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you,' and You do not break Your promise. And I ask You...
supplications.when_to_recite: When praying inside the Hateem (Hijr Ismail area) — considered inside the Kaaba; du'a is powerfully answered here

supplications.title: Du'a When Drinking Zamzam
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً وَرِزْقاً وَاسِعاً وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka 'ilman naafi'an wa rizqan waasi'an wa shifaa'an min kulli daa'
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision, and healing from every disease
supplications.when_to_recite: Before drinking Zamzam water — Zamzam is for whatever it is drunk for

supplications.title: Prayer at Maqam Ibrahim
supplications.arabic: وَاتَّخِذُوا مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى
supplications.transliteration: Wattakhidhoo mim-maqaami Ibraaheema musallaa
supplications.translation: And take the standing place of Ibrahim as a place of prayer — two rak'ah prayed here after Tawaf, reciting al-Kafirun and al-Ikhlas
supplications.when_to_recite: After completing Tawaf, pray two rak'ah behind Maqam Ibrahim

supplications.title: Upon Climbing Mount Safa
supplications.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Innassafaa wal-marwata min sha'aa'irillaah. Ab da'u bimaa bada'allaahu bih
supplications.translation: Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon reaching Mount Safa before starting Sa'i — a Sunnah statement of the Prophet ﷺ

supplications.title: Du'a Atop Mount Safa
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer. Laa ilaaha ill-Allaahu wahdah, anjaza wa'dah, wa nasara 'abdah, wa hazamal-ahzaaba wahdah
supplications.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner, to Whom belongs the dominion and all praise, and Who is over all things All-Powerful. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone; He fulfilled His promise, aided His servant, and alone defeated the confederates
supplications.when_to_recite: Standing atop Safa and Marwah — face the Kaaba and repeat this 3 times, making du'a between each repetition

supplications.title: Upon Arriving in Mina
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ هَذِهِ مِنًى فَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا مَنَنْتَ بِهِ عَلَى أَوْلِيَائِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma haadhihee Minaa famnum 'alayya bimaa mananta bihee 'alaa awliyaa'ik
supplications.translation: O Allah, this is Mina, so grant me of what You have granted to Your close friends
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon arriving in Mina — seeking to be among the accepted pilgrims

supplications.title: The Wuquf at Arafat
supplications.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, biyadihil-khayr, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
supplications.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. In His hand is all good and He is over all things All-Powerful
supplications.when_to_recite: The best du'a on the Day of Arafat — repeat throughout the standing (wuquf)

supplications.title: Takbeer During Days of Tashreeq
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahu Akbar, laa ilaaha ill-Allaah, wallaahu Akbar, Allaahu Akbar, walillaahil-hamd
supplications.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, none has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and to Allah belongs all praise
supplications.when_to_recite: During the Days of Tashreeq (11th, 12th, 13th Dhul-Hijjah) — after each prayer and when pelting the Jamarat

supplications.title: Du'a al-Kanz (Treasury Du'a)
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaan-Allaah, wal-hamdu lillaah, wa laa ilaaha ill-Allaah, wallaahu Akbar, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil-'Aliyyil-'Azeem
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, there is no deity but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power or strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great
supplications.when_to_recite: A treasure from the treasures of Paradise — said before sleeping

supplications.title: Four Phrases Beloved to Allah
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaan-Allaah, wal-hamdu lillaah, wa laa ilaaha ill-Allaah, wallaahu Akbar
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, there is no deity but Allah, Allah is the Greatest
supplications.when_to_recite: At all times — the Prophet ﷺ said these four phrases are the most beloved words to Allah

supplications.title: Last Three Verses of Surah al-Hashr
supplications.arabic: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Huwallaaul-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huw, 'Aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadah, Huwar-Rahmaan-ur-Raheem
supplications.translation: He is Allah, other than Whom there is no deity, the Knower of the unseen and witnessed. He is the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning — 3 times; 70,000 angels send blessings on you until evening

supplications.title: Ayat al-Kursi Before Sleep
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, Al-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhoo sinatuw-walaa nawm, lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ard...
supplications.translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth…
supplications.when_to_recite: Before sleeping — protects from Shaytan all night; an angel guards you

supplications.title: Last Two Ayat of Baqarah Before Sleeping
supplications.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Aamanar-rasulu bimaa unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihi wal-mu'minoon, kullun aamana billaahi wa malaa'ikatihee wa kutubihee wa rusulih...
supplications.translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers…
supplications.when_to_recite: Before sleep — these two ayat suffice whoever recites them (as protection)

supplications.title: Reciting Surah al-Mulk Every Night
supplications.arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Tabaarakal-ladhee biyadihil-mulku wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
supplications.translation: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the dominion, and He is over all things competent — (opening of Surah al-Mulk)
supplications.when_to_recite: Every night before sleeping — it is the 'Shield' and intercedes for its reciter

supplications.title: Complete Repentance (Tawbah Nasuha)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً فَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي وَاغْسِلْ حَوْبَتِي وَأَجِبْ دَعْوَتِي وَثَبِّتْ حُجَّتِي
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee tubtu ilayka tawbatan nasoohan faqbal tawbatee waghsil hawbatee wa ajib da'watee wa thabbit hujjatee
supplications.translation: O Allah, I repent to You with sincere repentance; accept my repentance, cleanse my sin, answer my supplication, and establish my proof
supplications.when_to_recite: When making sincere repentance and turning back to Allah

supplications.title: Seeking Forgiveness for Parents
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِناً
supplications.transliteration: Rabbigh-fir lee wa li-waalidayya wa li-man dakhala baytiya mu'minaa
supplications.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house as a believer
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of Prophet Nuh — seeking forgiveness for oneself, parents, and household

supplications.title: Seeking Forgiveness for All Muslims
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالإِيمَانِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lanaa wa li-ikhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaan
supplications.translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith
supplications.when_to_recite: Seeking forgiveness collectively for all believers — living and deceased

supplications.title: Seeking Forgiveness After Sinning
supplications.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
supplications.transliteration: Astaghfirullaahallladheee laa ilaaha illaa huwwal-Hayyul-Qayyoomu wa atoobu ilayh
supplications.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, there is no deity but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence, and I repent to Him
supplications.when_to_recite: Immediately after any sin — sins are forgiven through this formula

supplications.title: Signs That Du'a Is Accepted
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma taqabbal minnaa innaka antas-Samee'ul-'Aleem
supplications.translation: O Allah, accept from us; indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing
supplications.when_to_recite: After completing any act of worship — Ibrahim and Ismail made this du'a while building the Kaaba

supplications.title: Trusting Allah's Decision
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمُشْتَكَى وَأَنتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamd wa ilayk al-mushtakaa wa antal-musta'aan wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah
supplications.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise; to You I bring my complaint; You are the One sought for help; there is no power or strength except with Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling overwhelmed and turning all matters back to Allah

supplications.title: Full Submission After Du'a
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma anta tahkumu bayna 'ibaadika feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
supplications.translation: O Allah, You judge between Your servants in that which they used to differ
supplications.when_to_recite: After making du'a — submitting the outcome entirely to Allah's wisdom

supplications.title: Before Consummating the Marriage
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهَا وَبَارِكْ لَهَا فِيَّ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma baarik lee feehaa wa baarik lahaa feeyya
supplications.translation: O Allah, bless her for me and bless me for her
supplications.when_to_recite: Groom says this before the wedding night

supplications.title: Resolving Marital Conflict
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ بَيْنَنَا وَاجْعَلْ قُلُوبَنَا مُتَآلِفَةً
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aslih baynana waj'al quloobana muta'alifah
supplications.translation: O Allah, make peace between us and make our hearts affectionate toward each other
supplications.when_to_recite: During marital difficulties — praying for reconciliation and love

supplications.title: Second Du'a for a Righteous Spouse
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
supplications.translation: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need
supplications.when_to_recite: A subtle du'a for marriage — Prophet Musa made this after his good deed for the women at the well, and Allah granted him a spouse

supplications.title: Du'a in Sujood (Prostration)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahummaghfir lee dhanbee kullahoo diqqahoo wa jillahoo wa awwalahoo wa aakhirahoo wa 'alaaniyatahoo wa sirrah
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive all my sins, small and great, first and last, public and private
supplications.when_to_recite: During voluntary (nafl) sujood — the Prophet ﷺ used to say this in prostration

supplications.title: Between the Two Prostrations
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
supplications.transliteration: Rabbigh-fir lee, rabbigh-fir lee
supplications.translation: My Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me
supplications.when_to_recite: Between the two prostrations in prayer

supplications.title: Du'a in Ruku (Bowing)
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-'Azeem wa bihamdih
supplications.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent, and with His praise
supplications.when_to_recite: In the bowing position (ruku) of prayer

supplications.title: Second Du'a in Sujood
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى وَبِحَمْدِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-A'laa wa bihamdih
supplications.translation: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High, and with His praise
supplications.when_to_recite: During prostration (sujood) in prayer

supplications.title: Rising from Bowing
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbana wa lakal-hamd, hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubaarakan feeh
supplications.translation: Our Lord, and to You belongs all praise, much beautiful blessed praise
supplications.when_to_recite: After rising from ruku — said by the follower; the Prophet ﷺ praised this response

supplications.title: Protection for the Morning (7×)
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaahilladhee laa yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa huwas-Samee'ul-'Aleem
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah with Whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing
supplications.when_to_recite: 3 times in the morning and 3 times in the evening — nothing will harm you

supplications.title: Wiping the Body Before Sleep
supplications.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
supplications.transliteration: Qul huwal-laahu ahad, Qul a'oodhu birabbil-falaq, Qul a'oodhu birabbin-naas
supplications.translation: Recite the three Quls, blow into cupped hands, and wipe over the body — done three times before sleeping
supplications.when_to_recite: Before sleeping — the Prophet ﷺ did this every night

supplications.title: Bismillah When Entering Home
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaahi walajnaa wa bismillaahi kharajnaa
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave
supplications.when_to_recite: Every time you enter or leave your home — drives away Shaytan

supplications.title: Protection from Envy (Hasad)
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
supplications.transliteration: A'oodhu bi-kalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli 'aynin laammah
supplications.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature and from every evil eye
supplications.when_to_recite: Said over oneself or loved ones for protection from evil eye and envy

supplications.title: Entering the Morning in Full Submission
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ عَلَيكَ تَوَكَّلتُ وَأَنتَ رَبُّ الْعَرشِ الْعَظِيمِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma anta rabbee laa ilaaha illaa ant, 'alayka tawakkaltu wa anta Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azeem. Maa shaa'allaahu kaana wa maa lam yasha' lam yakun
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped but You, upon You I rely, and You are the Lord of the Great Throne. Whatever Allah wills happens, and whatever He does not will does not happen
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning — expressing full reliance on Allah for the day

supplications.title: Expiation for a Gathering (Kaffaratul Majlis)
supplications.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيكَ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaanaka Allaahumma wa bihamdika ash-hadu allaa ilaaha illaa anta astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk
supplications.translation: Glory be to You O Allah and with Your praise; I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You
supplications.when_to_recite: At the end of any gathering/meeting — expiates whatever wrong was said in the gathering

supplications.title: Bismillah Before Eating
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: Before eating — if one forgets, say: 'Bismillaahi awwalahu wa aakhirah' when remembering

supplications.title: Alhamdulillah After Eating
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahilladhee at'amanaa wa saqaanaa wa ja'alanaa muslimeen
supplications.translation: All praise is due to Allah Who has fed us and given us drink and made us Muslims
supplications.when_to_recite: After finishing a meal

supplications.title: Entering the Bathroom/Toilet
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah. Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khabaa'ith
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from male and female evil spirits
supplications.when_to_recite: Before entering the bathroom — always

supplications.title: Leaving the Bathroom
supplications.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
supplications.transliteration: Ghufraanak
supplications.translation: I ask You for forgiveness
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon leaving the bathroom/toilet

supplications.title: Short Du'a Before Sleep
supplications.arabic: بِسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
supplications.transliteration: Bismika Allaahumma amootu wa ahyaa
supplications.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live
supplications.when_to_recite: The moment you lie down to sleep

supplications.title: Waking Up (Short Form)
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
supplications.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahilladhee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa wa ilayhin-nushoor
supplications.translation: All praise is due to Allah Who has brought us back to life after causing us to die, and to Him is the return
supplications.when_to_recite: The very first thing upon waking — before getting up

supplications.title: When Getting Dressed
supplications.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
supplications.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahilladhee kasaanee haadha wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa laa quwwah
supplications.translation: All praise is due to Allah Who has clothed me with this and provided it for me without any power or strength from me
supplications.when_to_recite: When putting on any garment — past sins are forgiven

supplications.title: Wearing New Clothes
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنتَ كَسَوتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيرِهِ وَخَيرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamd anta kasawtaneehi as'aluka min khayrihee wa khayri maa suni'a lah, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihee wa sharri maa suni'a lah
supplications.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise. You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made
supplications.when_to_recite: When wearing a new garment for the first time

supplications.title: When Yawning
supplications.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-shaytaanir-rajeem
supplications.translation: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed Satan
supplications.when_to_recite: When yawning — cover the mouth and say this, for Shaytan laughs when we yawn

supplications.title: First Sight of the Kaaba (Detailed)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْ هَذَا الْبَيتَ تَشْرِيفاً وَتَعْظِيماً وَتَكْرِيماً وَمَهَابَةً وَزِدْ مَنْ شَرَّفَهُ وَكَرَّمَهُ مِمَّنْ حَجَّهُ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَهُ تَشْرِيفاً وَتَكْرِيماً وَتَعْظِيماً وَبِرّاً
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma zid haadhhal-bayta tashreefan wa ta'zeeman wa takreeman wa mahaabatan, wa zid man sharrafahoo wa karramahoo mimman hajjahoo aw i'tamarahoo tashreefan wa takreeman wa ta'zeeman wa birraa
supplications.translation: O Allah, increase this House in honor, esteem, dignity, and awe, and increase those who honor and revere it — those who perform Hajj or Umrah — in honor, esteem, dignity, and righteousness
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon first seeing the Kaaba — raise hands and make du'a

supplications.title: The Special Hour of Jumu'ah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيرَ الدُّنيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka khayr-ad-dunyaa wal-aaakhirah
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the best of this world and the next
supplications.when_to_recite: In the last hour before Maghrib on Friday — the hour of answered du'a

supplications.title: Making Du'a When It Rains
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma sayyiban naafi'aa
supplications.translation: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain
supplications.when_to_recite: When rain falls — du'a during rain is answered

supplications.title: After Rain Falls
supplications.arabic: مُطِرنَا بِفَضلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحمَتِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Mutirna bifadlillaahi wa rahmatih
supplications.translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: After it rains — attributing the blessing to Allah, not to stars or weather

supplications.title: Seeing a Good Dream
supplications.arabic: الْحَمدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ الرُّؤيَا الصَّالِحَةَ بُشرَى
supplications.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahilladhee ja'alar-ru'yas-saalihata bushraa
supplications.translation: All praise is due to Allah Who made a righteous dream a glad tiding
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon waking from a good dream — then tell a loved one or a wise person

supplications.title: Du'a for Aging Parents (Detailed)
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ ارحَمهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيراً
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi irhamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheera
supplications.translation: My Lord, have mercy on them both as they raised me when I was small
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — especially when parents are alive and aging

supplications.title: Du'a for a Child's Health
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذهُ بِكَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَّاتِ مِن كُلِّ شَيطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِن كُلِّ عَينٍ لاَمَّةٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma a'idhhu bi-kalimaatika't-taammaati min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli 'aynin laammah
supplications.translation: O Allah, protect him/her by Your perfect words from every devil, every poisonous creature, and every evil eye
supplications.when_to_recite: Said over a sick or vulnerable child — Sunnah taught by the Prophet ﷺ

supplications.title: Du'a at a Child's Birth (Tahnik)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِيهِ وَبَارِكْ لِوَالِدَيهِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma baarik feeh wa baarik li-waalidayh
supplications.translation: O Allah, bless him/her and bless his/her parents
supplications.when_to_recite: At the Tahnik ceremony (rubbing chewed date on the baby's palate) after birth

supplications.title: Saying Farewell to a Loved One
supplications.arabic: أَستَودِعُكَ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
supplications.transliteration: Astawdi'ukallaahalladzee laa tadee'u wadaa'i'uh
supplications.translation: I entrust you to Allah, Whose trusts are never lost
supplications.when_to_recite: When parting from a family member for a journey

supplications.title: Du'a Encompassing All Needs
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اصلِح لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصمَةُ أَمرِي وَأَصلِح لِي دُنيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصلِح لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aslih lee deenee alladhee huwa 'ismat amree, wa aslih lee dunyaaya allatee feehaa ma'aashee, wa aslih lee aakhiratee allatee feehaa ma'aadee
supplications.translation: O Allah, rectify for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs; rectify for me my world wherein is my livelihood; and rectify for me my Hereafter to which is my return
supplications.when_to_recite: Comprehensive du'a covering this life and the next — from the Prophet's ﷺ own prayers

supplications.title: Increase in Faith
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسأَلُكَ الإِيمَانَ الدَّائِمَ وَأَسأَلُكَ قَلباً سَلِيماً وَأَسأَلُكَ عَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-eemaanad-daa'im, wa as'aluka qalban saleemal, wa as'aluka 'amalan mutaqabbalaa
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for enduring faith, a sound heart, and accepted deeds
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — seeking the essentials of the spiritual life

supplications.title: Du'a for the Highest Paradise
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسأَلُكَ الفِردَوسَ الأَعلَى
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-Firdawsal-a'laa
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the highest Paradise (al-Firdaws)
supplications.when_to_recite: The highest goal — ask Allah for the highest degree of Paradise; He loves that we aim high

supplications.title: Not to Forget Allah's Blessings
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجعَلنِي شَكُوراً وَاجعَلنِي صَبُوراً وَاجعَلنِي فِي عَينِي صَغِيراً وَفِي أَعيُنِ النَّاسِ كَبِيراً
supplications.transliteration: Allaahummaj'alnee shakooraw-waj'alnee sabooraw-waj'alnee fee 'aynee sagheera wa fee a'yunin-naasi kabeera
supplications.translation: O Allah, make me grateful, patient, small in my own eyes, and great in the eyes of the people
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning — seeking good character and proper self-perspective

supplications.title: Sealing Life with Goodness
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحسِن عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا وَأَجِرنَا مِن خِزيِ الدُّنيَا وَعَذَابِ الآخِرَةِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma ahsin 'aaqibatanaa fil-umori kullihaa wa ajirnaa min khizyid-dunyaa wa 'adhaabil-aakhirah
supplications.translation: O Allah, make our end in all affairs good, and save us from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter
supplications.when_to_recite: Evening — asking for a good conclusion to every matter in life

supplications.title: Du'a Using Allah's Names
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسأَلُكَ بِاسمِكَ الأَعظَمِ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ أَجَبتَ وَإِذَا سُئِلتَ بِهِ أَعطَيتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka bi-asmikal-a'zam, alladzee idhaa du'eeta bihee ajabta, wa idhaa su'ilta bihee a'tayt
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your Greatest Name, by which when You are called upon You respond, and when You are asked You give
supplications.when_to_recite: Before an important du'a — seeking Allah through His supreme Name

supplications.title: Fear of Enemies or Oppressors
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكفِنِيهِم بِمَا شِئتَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma akfineehi/hum bimaa shi't
supplications.translation: O Allah, protect me/us from them however You will
supplications.when_to_recite: When fearing oppression or harm from people

supplications.title: Replacing Grief with Joy
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبدُكَ ابنُ عَبدِكَ ابنُ أَمَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكمُكَ عَدلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee 'abduka ibnu 'abdika ibnu amatika, naasiyatee biyadik, maadin fiyya hukmuk, 'adlun fiyya qadaa'uk
supplications.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your servant, the son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand, Your command over me is forever executed, Your decree over me is just
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a for removing grief and sorrow — Allah substitutes worry with joy

supplications.title: Overwhelming Debt and Worry
supplications.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحمَتِكَ أَستَغِيثُ
supplications.transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom, bi-rahmatika astaghees
supplications.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help
supplications.when_to_recite: In severe difficulty, crisis, or when overwhelmed — a cry to Allah's essential attributes

supplications.title: Returning to Allah in Calamity
supplications.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيهِ رَاجِعُونَ
supplications.transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raaji'oon
supplications.translation: Indeed, to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon any loss, accident, hardship, or news of calamity

supplications.title: Sudden Fear or Shock
supplications.arabic: حَسبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعمَ الوَكِيلُ
supplications.transliteration: Hasbunallaahu wa ni'mal-wakeel
supplications.translation: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best Disposer of affairs
supplications.when_to_recite: When suddenly frightened, shocked, or threatened — the words of Ibrahim upon being thrown in the fire

supplications.title: 100 Istighfar Daily
supplications.arabic: أَستَغفِرُ اللَّهَ
supplications.transliteration: Astaghfirullaah (×100)
supplications.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah — repeated 100 times per day
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily routine — the Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness 100 times per day

supplications.title: Durud Ibrahim (Complete)
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيتَ عَلَى إِبرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِك عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكتَ عَلَى إِبرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, kamaa sallayta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheem. Innaka Hameedun Majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, kamaa baarakta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheem. Innaka Hameedun Majeed
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim — truly You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim — truly You are Praiseworthy and Glorious
supplications.when_to_recite: In every prayer (tashahhud) and frequently — the complete form of salawat

supplications.title: Subhanallah 100 Times
supplications.arabic: سُبحَانَ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaan-Allaah (×100)
supplications.translation: Glory be to Allah — repeated 100 times
supplications.when_to_recite: Sitting — 100 times removes 1000 sins or raises 1000 degrees

supplications.title: La Ilaha Illallah 100 Times
supplications.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allaah (×100)
supplications.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah — repeated 100 times
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — intercedes on the Day of Judgment

supplications.title: Abundant Salawat on Friday
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّم عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa nabiyyinaa Muhammad
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad
supplications.when_to_recite: Abundantly on Fridays — sent to the Prophet ﷺ directly on this day

supplications.title: Rabbana Atina (Short)
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbana aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'adhaaban-naar
supplications.translation: Our Lord, give us in this world what is good and in the Hereafter what is good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire
supplications.when_to_recite: The Prophet ﷺ said this du'a most frequently — while walking between Safa and Marwah and at all times

supplications.title: Rabbana Zalamna (Short)
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمنَا أَنفُسَنَا
supplications.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusanaa
supplications.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves
supplications.when_to_recite: A brief but heartfelt acknowledgment of wrongdoing before elaborating

supplications.title: Du'a of Ayyub (Job)
supplications.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Annee massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-raahimeen
supplications.translation: Adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of those who are merciful
supplications.when_to_recite: In illness, prolonged suffering, or any type of hardship — the du'a that ended Prophet Ayyub's years of illness

supplications.title: Du'a of Ibrahim in the Fire
supplications.arabic: حَسبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعمَ الوَكِيلُ
supplications.transliteration: Hasbunallaahu wa ni'mal-wakeel
supplications.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs
supplications.when_to_recite: Ibrahim said this when thrown into the fire — recite in any extreme danger or helplessness

supplications.title: Du'a of Musa Fleeing Persecution
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ القَومِ الظَّالِمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi najjinee minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
supplications.translation: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people
supplications.when_to_recite: When oppressed or in danger from unjust people

supplications.title: Midday Dhikr
supplications.arabic: سُبحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمدِهِ سُبحَانَ اللَّهِ العَظِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaan-Allaahi wa bihamdih, Subhaan-Allaahil-'Azeem
supplications.translation: Glory and praise be to Allah; Glory be to Allah the Magnificent
supplications.when_to_recite: Midday or after Dhuhr — light on the tongue, heavy on the scale

supplications.title: Morning Du'a for Well-being
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'aafiyata fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the next
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning and evening — 'afiyah (well-being) is the greatest gift after certainty

supplications.title: Du'a for Retaining Knowledge
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انفَعنِي بِمَا عَلَّمتَنِي وَعَلِّمنِي مَا يَنفَعُنِي
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma anfa'nee bimaa 'allamtanee wa 'allimni maa yanfa'unee
supplications.translation: O Allah, benefit me by what You have taught me, and teach me what will benefit me
supplications.when_to_recite: After study and learning sessions

supplications.title: Du'a for Lifting Depression
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الكَسَلِ وَالهَرَمِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-kasali wal-haram
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from laziness and senility
supplications.when_to_recite: For low energy, sadness, or lack of motivation

supplications.title: Du'a for a Good Travel Companion
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهلِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma anta's-saahibu fis-safari wal-khaleefatu fil-ahl
supplications.translation: O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian of the family
supplications.when_to_recite: When beginning a journey — the Prophet ﷺ said this then added the traveler's du'a

supplications.title: Finding Lost Belongings
supplications.arabic: يَا جَامِعَ النَّاسِ لِيَومٍ لَا رَيبَ فِيهِ اجمَع لِي ضَالَّتِي
supplications.transliteration: Yaa Jaami'an-naasi li-yawmin laa rayba feeh, ijma' lee daallati
supplications.translation: O Gatherer of people for a day about which there is no doubt, gather for me what I have lost
supplications.when_to_recite: When searching for lost belongings

supplications.title: Entering the Cemetery
supplications.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيكُم أَهلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ المُؤمِنِينَ وَالمُسلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُم لاَحِقُونَ
supplications.transliteration: As-Salaamu 'alaykum ahla'd-diyaari minal-mu'mineena wal-muslimeen, wa innaa in shaa'-Allaahu bikum laahiqoon
supplications.translation: Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of the graves from the believers and Muslims. Indeed, Allah willing, we will join you
supplications.when_to_recite: When entering a cemetery — Sunnah of the Prophet ﷺ

supplications.title: Visiting the Sick (Third Form)
supplications.arabic: لاَ بَأسَ طَهُورٌ إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ba'sa, tahoorun in shaa'-Allaah
supplications.translation: Do not worry, it is a purification, if Allah wills
supplications.when_to_recite: Said to someone who is ill — illness expiates sins

supplications.title: Seeking Halal Wealth
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغنِنِي بِالحَلاَلِ عَنِ الحَرَامِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aghnini bil-halaali 'anil-haraam
supplications.translation: O Allah, make me sufficiently wealthy through the lawful so that I have no need of what is unlawful
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning — asking for sufficiency through halal means

supplications.title: Before Starting Work
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسأَلُكَ خَيرَ هَذَا اليَومِ فَتحَهُ وَنَصرَهُ وَنُورَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka khayra haadhil-yawmi, fathahu wa nasrahu wa noorahu wa barakatah
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its opening, its victory, its light, and its blessings
supplications.when_to_recite: At the start of a work day or project

supplications.title: Completing a Reading of the Quran
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارحَمنِي بِالقُرآنِ وَاجعَلهُ لِي إِمَاماً وَنُوراً وَهُدىً وَرَحمَةً
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma irhamni bil-Qur'aani waj'alhu lee imaaman wa nooraw-wa hudaw-wa rahmah
supplications.translation: O Allah, have mercy on me through the Quran and make it for me an imam, a light, a guide, and a mercy
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon completing a full recitation of the Quran

supplications.title: When Listening to the Quran
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكتُب نَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbana aamannaa fak-tubnaa ma'ash-shaaahideen
supplications.translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses
supplications.when_to_recite: When moved by the recitation of the Quran

supplications.title: Seeking the Rank of Martyr
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارزُقنِي الشَّهَادَةَ فِي سَبِيلِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma arzuqni ash-shahaadata fee sabeelika
supplications.translation: O Allah, grant me martyrdom in Your cause
supplications.when_to_recite: Sincerely asking for the highest rank — whoever asks sincerely receives it even if they die in bed

supplications.title: For the Guidance of Non-Muslims
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهدِ قَومِي فَإِنَّهُم لاَ يَعلَمُونَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma ahdi qawmee fa-innahum laa ya'lamoon
supplications.translation: O Allah, guide my people, for they do not know
supplications.when_to_recite: For non-Muslim family, friends, or the broader world — words of the Prophet ﷺ

supplications.title: Trusting in Ease After Hardship
supplications.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ العُسرِ يُسراً إِنَّ مَعَ العُسرِ يُسراً
supplications.transliteration: Fa-inna ma'al-'usri yusraa, inna ma'al-'usri yusr
supplications.translation: For indeed, with hardship will be ease. Indeed, with hardship will be ease
supplications.when_to_recite: Recite during hardship as a reminder — Allah repeats it twice as a promise

supplications.title: Relying on Allah Completely
supplications.arabic: أُفَوِّضُ أَمرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالعِبَادِ
supplications.transliteration: Ufawwidu amree ilallaah, innal-laaha baseerun bil-'ibaad
supplications.translation: I delegate my affair to Allah; indeed Allah is Watchful of His servants
supplications.when_to_recite: Said by the believer in Al-Mu'min 44 — their enemy was destroyed

supplications.title: Protection from Arrogance and Pride
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجعَلنِي مِمَّن إِذَا أُعطِيَ بَطِرَ وَإِذَا ابتُلِيَ صَبَرَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma laa taj'alnee mimman idhaa u'tiya batira wa idhaa ubtuliyas-sabara
supplications.translation: O Allah, do not make me of those who become arrogant when given blessings, or patient only when afflicted — but truly patient at all times

supplications.title: The Quran as Cure for the Heart
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجعَل القُرآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلبِي وَنُورَ صَدرِي وَجَلاَءَ حُزنِي وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aj'alil-Qur'aana rabee'a qalbee wa noora sadree wa jalaa'a huznee wa dhahaaba hammee
supplications.translation: O Allah, make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness, and the remover of my anxiety
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — seeking to be among the People of the Quran

supplications.title: Special Night-Prayer Sujood Du'a
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغفِر لِي مَا أَسرَرتُ وَمَا أَعلَنتُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahummaghfir lee maa asrartu wa maa a'lant
supplications.translation: O Allah, forgive me for what I have done in secret and what I have done openly
supplications.when_to_recite: In sujood — especially in night prayer

supplications.title: Peace in the Heart
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ألِّف بَينَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصلِح ذَاتَ بَينِنَا
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma allif bayna quloobinaa wa aslih dhaata bayninaa
supplications.translation: O Allah, bring our hearts together and reconcile between us
supplications.when_to_recite: For community and family unity

supplications.title: Du'a for Accepted Hajj
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّل مِنَّا وَاجعَل حَجَّنَا مَبرُوراً وَسَعيَنَا مَشكُوراً وَذَنبَنَا مَغفُوراً
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma taqabbal minnaa waj'al hajjanaa mabrooraw-wa sa'yanaa mashkooraw-wa dhanbanaa maghfooraa
supplications.translation: O Allah, accept from us and make our Hajj accepted, our effort appreciated, and our sins forgiven
supplications.when_to_recite: Throughout Hajj — the comprehensive du'a for the pilgrim

supplications.title: Du'a on Eid Day
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجعَل خَيرَ عُمُرِي آخِرَهُ وَخَيرَ عَمَلِي خَواتِمَهُ وَخَيرَ أَيَّامِي يَومَ أَلقَاكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aj'al khayra 'umuree aakhirah, wa khayra 'amalee khawaatimah, wa khayra ayyaamee yawma alqaak
supplications.translation: O Allah, make the best of my life its end, the best of my deeds their final ones, and the best of my days the day I meet You
supplications.when_to_recite: On Eid or any celebratory occasion — turning celebration toward the ultimate meeting

supplications.title: Du'a in the Salat al-Istisqa
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسقِنَا غَيثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً نَافِعاً غَيرَ ضَارٍّ عَاجِلاً غَيرَ آجِلٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma asqinaa ghaythan mugheetha maree'an maree'an naafi'an ghayra daarin 'aajilan ghayra aajil
supplications.translation: O Allah, send us rain — relieving, wholesome, fruitful, beneficial, not harmful, soon and not delayed
supplications.when_to_recite: During the prayer for rain (Salat al-Istisqa) or in times of drought

supplications.title: Entering a New City or Place
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبعِ وَمَا أَظلَلنَ وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبعِ وَمَا أَقلَلنَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i wa maa azlalna wa Rabbal-aradheenas-sab'i wa maa aqlaln
supplications.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they shade, and Lord of the seven earths and all they carry
supplications.when_to_recite: When entering a new city or place — the full du'a includes asking for the good of its people and seeking refuge from its evil

supplications.title: Salat al-Tawbah (Two Rak'ah of Repentance)
supplications.arabic: نَوَيتُ أَن أُصَلِّيَ رَكعَتَينِ تَوبَةً لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى
supplications.transliteration: Nawaytu an usalliya rak'atayn tawbatan lillaahi ta'aalaa
supplications.translation: I intend to pray two rak'ah of repentance for the sake of Allah the Exalted
supplications.when_to_recite: After any sin — pray two rak'ah, then make sincere tawbah; Allah forgives

supplications.title: Salat al-Hajah (Prayer of Need)
supplications.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الحَلِيمُ الكَرِيمُ سُبحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَرشِ العَظِيمِ
supplications.transliteration: Laa ilaaha ill-Allaahul-Haleem-ul-Kareem, subhaanal-laahi Rabbil-'Arshil-'Azeem
supplications.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the Great Throne
supplications.when_to_recite: After two rak'ah of Salat al-Hajah (prayer of need) — then make specific du'a for what you need

supplications.title: Before Memorizing Quran
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى حِفظِ كِتَابِكَ وَتِلاَوَتِهِ وَتَدَبُّرِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma a'innee 'alaa hifzi kitaabika wa tilaawatihee wa tadabburih
supplications.translation: O Allah, help me to memorize Your Book, recite it, and reflect on it
supplications.when_to_recite: Before beginning a Quran memorization session

supplications.title: Softening a Hard Heart
supplications.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ القُلُوبِ ثَبِّت قَلبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Yaa Muqallibal-quloob, thabbit qalbee 'alaa deenika
supplications.translation: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm on Your religion
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling spiritually distant or hard-hearted

supplications.title: Visiting Masjid al-Nabawi in Madinah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَافتَح لِي أَبوَابَ رَحمَتِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammad wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, waftah lee abwaaba rahmatik
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and open for me the gates of Your mercy
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon entering Masjid al-Nabawi in Madinah

supplications.title: Salutation at the Prophet's Grave ﷺ
supplications.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَرَحمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
supplications.transliteration: As-Salaamu 'alayka yaa Rasoolallaah, wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuh
supplications.translation: Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings
supplications.when_to_recite: When visiting the grave of the Prophet ﷺ in Madinah

supplications.title: Full Du'a at the Time of Udhiyah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّل مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلتَ مِن إِبرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma taqabbal minnee kamaa taqabbalta min Ibraaheema khaleelika
supplications.translation: O Allah, accept from me just as You accepted from Ibrahim, Your friend
supplications.when_to_recite: When slaughtering the Udhiyah (Qurbani/sacrificial animal) on Eid al-Adha

supplications.title: Neither Poverty nor Excess
supplications.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصرِف عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَاماً
supplications.transliteration: Rabbanasrif 'annaa 'adhaaba jahannama inna 'adhaabahaa kaana gharaamaa
supplications.translation: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is an ever-present affliction
supplications.when_to_recite: For protection from the greatest calamity — Hellfire

supplications.title: Humility in Knowledge
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَن أَقُولَ عَلَيكَ مَا لَا أَعلَمُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika an aqoola 'alayka maa laa a'lam
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from saying about You what I do not know
supplications.when_to_recite: Before speaking on religious matters — guarding against speaking without knowledge

supplications.title: Du'a at the Loss of a Loved One
supplications.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أجُرنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخلِف لِي خَيراً مِنهَا
supplications.transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raaji'oon. Allaahumma ajurnee fee museebatee wa akhlif lee khayran minhaa
supplications.translation: To Allah we belong and to Him we return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it with something better for me
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon the death of a loved one — Umm Salamah (ra) said this and was given the Prophet ﷺ as a replacement

supplications.title: Du'a for a Just Leader
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَن وَلِيَ مِن أَمرِ أُمَّتِي شَيئاً فَأَرفَق بِهِم وَمَن شَقَّ عَلَيهِم فَاشقُق عَلَيهِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma man waliya min amri ummatee shay'an fa-arfaqa bihim... wa man shaqqa 'alayhim fashquq 'alayh
supplications.translation: O Allah, whoever is given authority over my ummah's affairs and is kind to them... and whoever causes them hardship, cause him hardship
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of the Prophet ﷺ — for just leadership in the ummah

supplications.title: Prayer to Enter Paradise Without Reckoning
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجعَلنِي مِنَ السَّبعِينَ أَلفاً الَّذِينَ يَدخُلُونَ الجَنَّةَ بِغَيرِ حِسَابٍ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aj'alnee minas-sab'eena alfan alladheena yadkhuloona al-jannata bi-ghayri hisaab
supplications.translation: O Allah, make me among the seventy thousand who enter Paradise without reckoning
supplications.when_to_recite: Regularly — asking for the greatest exemption on Judgment Day

supplications.title: The Cry of the Utterly Needy
supplications.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ
supplications.transliteration: Yaa Rabbi, yaa Rabbi
supplications.translation: O my Lord! O my Lord!
supplications.when_to_recite: When words fail and only the heart speaks — even this bare plea is heard by Allah

supplications.title: Du'a Attributed to Imam al-Shafi'i
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصلِح قَلبِي وَلِسَانِي وَنِيَّتِي وَعَمَلِي وَيَقِينِي
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aslih qalbee wa lisaanee wa niyyatee wa 'amalee wa yaqeenee
supplications.translation: O Allah, rectify my heart, my tongue, my intention, my deeds, and my certainty
supplications.when_to_recite: Daily — comprehensive prayer for all the pillars of righteous character

supplications.title: Complete Bounty of Allah
supplications.arabic: الْحَمدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
supplications.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahilladhee bi-ni'matihee tatimmu as-saalihaat
supplications.translation: All praise is for Allah, by Whose grace all righteous deeds are completed
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon completing any good deed — gratitude for divine facilitation

supplications.title: Joy at Success
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الحَمدُ كُلُّهُ وَلَكَ الشُّكرُ كُلُّهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamdu kulluh, wa lakash-shukru kulluh
supplications.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, and to You belongs all gratitude
supplications.when_to_recite: When something wonderful happens — channeling joy toward gratitude

supplications.title: Du'a of Hope in Allah
supplications.arabic: لَا تَقنَطُوا مِن رَّحمَةِ اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Laa taqnatu mir-rahmatillaah
supplications.translation: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: When feeling hopeless — Allah's mercy encompasses all things

supplications.title: Placing Trust in Allah (Simple)
supplications.arabic: تَوَكَّلتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ
supplications.transliteration: Tawakkaltu 'alal-laah
supplications.translation: I place my trust in Allah
supplications.when_to_recite: Before any task or decision — the simplest expression of tawakkul

supplications.title: Entering the Market (Short Form)
supplications.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُم إِنِّي أَسأَلُكَ خَيرَ هَذَا السُّوقِ
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah. Allaahumma innee as'aluka khayra haadha's-sooq
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this marketplace
supplications.when_to_recite: When entering any commercial area

supplications.title: When Seeing Dark Clouds
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّهَا
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from its evil
supplications.when_to_recite: When dark storm clouds appear — the Prophet ﷺ would become concerned and make du'a

supplications.title: Salutation on All Prophets
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى جَمِيعِ أَنبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa jamee'i anbiyaa'ika wa rusulika
supplications.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon all Your prophets and messengers
supplications.when_to_recite: A comprehensive salutation honoring all the prophets of Allah

supplications.title: Seeking Wisdom (Hikmah)
supplications.arabic: رَبِّ هَب لِي حُكماً وَأَلحِقنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukman wa alhiqnee bis-saaliheen
supplications.translation: My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous
supplications.when_to_recite: Du'a of Prophet Ibrahim — seeking wisdom and righteous company

supplications.title: Wishing for Good Dreams
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسأَلُكَ رُؤيَا صَالِحَةً
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka ru'yan saalihah
supplications.translation: O Allah, I ask You for a righteous dream
supplications.when_to_recite: Before sleeping — asking Allah for good dreams as guidance

supplications.title: Du'a Before Intimacy
supplications.arabic: بِاسمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبنَا الشَّيطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيطَانَ مَا رَزَقتَنَا
supplications.transliteration: Bismillaah. Allaahumma jannibna ash-shaytaan wa jannibish-shaytaana maa razaqtanaa
supplications.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep us away from Shaytan and keep Shaytan away from what You grant us
supplications.when_to_recite: Between spouses before intimacy — if a child is born, Shaytan will not harm them

supplications.title: The Two Weighty Things
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِن سَخَطِكَ وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِن عُقُوبَتِكَ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu biridaaka min sakhatik, wa bimu'aafaatika min 'uqoobatik
supplications.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, and in Your pardon from Your punishment
supplications.when_to_recite: The Prophet ﷺ said he could not fully praise Allah — then said this

supplications.title: Arriving in Madinah al-Munawwarah
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا حَرَمُ رَسُولِكَ فَاجعَلهُ لِي وِقَايَةً مِنَ النَّارِ وَأَمَاناً مِنَ العَذَابِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma haadha haramu rasoolika faj'alhu lee wiqaayatan minan-naar wa amaanan minal-'adhaab
supplications.translation: O Allah, this is the sanctuary of Your Messenger, so make it for me a shield from the Fire and security from punishment
supplications.when_to_recite: Upon arriving in Madinah al-Munawwarah for the first time

supplications.title: Du'a for One's Teacher
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجزِ عَنِّي مُعَلِّمِي خَيراً وَبَارِك لَهُ فِي عِلمِهِ وَعُمُرِهِ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma ajzi 'annee mu'allimee khayran wa baarik lahoo fee 'ilmihee wa 'umuree
supplications.translation: O Allah, recompense my teacher well on my behalf and bless him/her in their knowledge and their life
supplications.when_to_recite: For one's teachers, scholars, and instructors

supplications.title: Seeking Help Through Prayer
supplications.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا استَعِينُوا بِالصَّبرِ وَالصَّلاَةِ
supplications.transliteration: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo ista'eenoo bis-sabri was-salaah
supplications.translation: O you who believe, seek help through patience and prayer
supplications.when_to_recite: In hardship — recite and implement: pray two rak'ah and be patient

supplications.title: Sincerity in Worship
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجعَل أَعمَالَنَا كُلَّهَا صَالِحَةً وَاجعَلهَا لِوَجهِكَ خَالِصَةً
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma aj'al a'maalanaa kullahaa saalihatan waj'alhaa liwajhika khaalisah
supplications.translation: O Allah, make all our deeds righteous and make them purely for Your sake
supplications.when_to_recite: Morning — seeking ikhlas (sincerity) in all actions for the day

supplications.title: The Quran in the Heart
supplications.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقرَأ بِي القُرآنَ وَتَدَبَّر بِي مَعَانِيَهُ
supplications.transliteration: Allaahumma iqra' bil-Qur'aana wa tadabbar bimaa'aniyyah
supplications.translation: O Allah, let me recite the Quran and reflect deeply on its meanings

supplications.title: The Final Word
supplications.arabic: سُبحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ العِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ وَسَلاَمٌ عَلَى المُرسَلِينَ وَالحَمدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ
supplications.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbika Rabbil-'izzati 'ammaa yasifoon, wa salaamun 'alal-mursaleen, wal-hamdu lillaahi Rabbil-'aalameen
supplications.translation: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Honor, above what they describe. And peace be upon the Messengers. And all praise is due to Allah, Lord of the Worlds
supplications.when_to_recite: A closing glorification of Allah — the final verses of Surah al-Saffat
